   268	)
   269	
   270	// ErrReadonly indicates a failure when attempting to run maintenance on a read-only repository.
   271	var ErrReadonly = errors.New("not running maintenance on read-only repository connection")
   272	
   273	// Run runs the complete snapshot and repository maintenance.
   274	func Run(ctx context.Context, dr repo.DirectRepositoryWriter, mode maintenance.Mode, force bool, safety maintenance.SafetyParameters) error {
   275		if dr.ClientOptions().ReadOnly {
   276			return ErrReadonly
   277		}
   278	
   279		dr.LogManager().Enable()
   280	
   281		//nolint:wrapcheck
   282		return maintenance.RunExclusive(ctx, dr, mode, force,
   283			func(ctx context.Context, runParams maintenance.RunParameters) error {
   284				// run snapshot GC before full maintenance
   285				if runParams.Mode == maintenance.ModeFull {
   286					if err := snapshotgc.Run(ctx, dr, true, safety, runParams.MaintenanceStartTime); err != nil {
   287						return errors.Wrap(err, "snapshot GC failure")
   288					}
   289				}
   290	
   291				//nolint:wrapcheck
   292				return maintenance.Run(ctx, runParams, safety)
   293			})
   294	}
   295	package maintenance
   296	
   297	import "time"
   298	
   299	// SafetyParameters specifies timing parameters that affect safety of maintenance.
   300	type SafetyParameters struct {
   301		// Do not rewrite contents younger than this age.
   302		RewriteMinAge time.Duration
   303	
   304		// Snapshot GC: MinContentAgeSubjectToGC is the minimum age of content to be subject to garbage collection.
   305		MinContentAgeSubjectToGC time.Duration
   306	
   307		// MarginBetweenSnapshotGC is the minimal amount of time that must pass between snapshot
   308		// GC cycles to allow all in-flight snapshots during earlier GC to be flushed and
   309		// visible to a following GC. The uploader will automatically create a checkpoint every 45 minutes,
   310		// so ~1 hour should be enough but we're setting this to a higher conservative value for extra safety.
   311		MarginBetweenSnapshotGC time.Duration
   312	
   313		// RequireTwoGCCycles indicates that two GC cycles are required.
   314		RequireTwoGCCycles bool
   315	
   316		// DisableEventualConsistencySafety disables wait time to allow settling of eventually-consistent writes in blob stores.
   317		DisableEventualConsistencySafety bool
   318	
   319		// DropContentFromIndexExtraMargin is the amount of margin time before dropping deleted contents from indices.
   320		DropContentFromIndexExtraMargin time.Duration
   321	
   322		// Blob GC: Delete unused blobs above this age.
   323		PackDeleteMinAge time.Duration
   324	
   325		// Blob GC: Drop incomplete session blobs above this age.
   326		SessionExpirationAge time.Duration
   327	
   328		// Minimum time that must pass after content rewrite before we delete orphaned blobs.
   329		MinRewriteToOrphanDeletionDelay time.Duration
   330	}
   331	
   332	// Supported safety levels.
   333	//
   334	//nolint:gochecknoglobals
   335	var (
   336		// SafetyNone has safety parameters which allow full garbage collection without unnecessary
   337		// delays, but it is safe only if no other kopia clients are running and storage backend is
   338		// strongly consistent.
   339		SafetyNone = SafetyParameters{
   340			PackDeleteMinAge:                 0,
   341			DropContentFromIndexExtraMargin:  0,
   342			MarginBetweenSnapshotGC:          0,
   343			MinContentAgeSubjectToGC:         0,
   344			RewriteMinAge:                    0,
   345			SessionExpirationAge:             0,
   346			RequireTwoGCCycles:               false,
   347			DisableEventualConsistencySafety: true,
   348		}
   349	
   350		// SafetyFull has default safety parameters which allow safe GC concurrent with snapshotting
   351		// by other Kopia clients.
   352		SafetyFull = SafetyParameters{
   353			PackDeleteMinAge:                24 * time.Hour, //nolint:mnd
   354			DropContentFromIndexExtraMargin: time.Hour,
   355			MarginBetweenSnapshotGC:         4 * time.Hour,  //nolint:mnd
   356			MinContentAgeSubjectToGC:        24 * time.Hour, //nolint:mnd
   357			RewriteMinAge:                   2 * time.Hour,  //nolint:mnd
   358			SessionExpirationAge:            96 * time.Hour, //nolint:mnd
   359			RequireTwoGCCycles:              true,
   360			MinRewriteToOrphanDeletionDelay: time.Hour,
   361		}
   362	)

   266		"github.com/kopia/kopia/repo/maintenance"
   267		"github.com/kopia/kopia/snapshot/snapshotgc"
   268	)
   269	
   270	// ErrReadonly indicates a failure when attempting to run maintenance on a read-only repository.
   271	var ErrReadonly = errors.New("not running maintenance on read-only repository connection")
   272	
   273	// Run runs the complete snapshot and repository maintenance.
   274	func Run(ctx context.Context, dr repo.DirectRepositoryWriter, mode maintenance.Mode, force bool, safety maintenance.SafetyParameters) error {
   275		if dr.ClientOptions().ReadOnly {
   276			return ErrReadonly
   277		}
   278	
   279		dr.LogManager().Enable()
   280	
   281		//nolint:wrapcheck
   282		return maintenance.RunExclusive(ctx, dr, mode, force,
   283			func(ctx context.Context, runParams maintenance.RunParameters) error {
   284				// run snapshot GC before full maintenance
   285				if runParams.Mode == maintenance.ModeFull {
   286					if err := snapshotgc.Run(ctx, dr, true, safety, runParams.MaintenanceStartTime); err != nil {
   287						return errors.Wrap(err, "snapshot GC failure")
   288					}
   289				}
   290	
   291				//nolint:wrapcheck
   292				return maintenance.Run(ctx, runParams, safety)
   293			})
   294	}
   295	package maintenance
   296	
   297	import "time"
   298	
   299	// SafetyParameters specifies timing parameters that affect safety of maintenance.
   300	type SafetyParameters struct {
   301		// Do not rewrite contents younger than this age.
   302		RewriteMinAge time.Duration
   303	
   304		// Snapshot GC: MinContentAgeSubjectToGC is the minimum age of content to be subject to garbage collection.
   305		MinContentAgeSubjectToGC time.Duration
   306	
   307		// MarginBetweenSnapshotGC is the minimal amount of time that must pass between snapshot
   308		// GC cycles to allow all in-flight snapshots during earlier GC to be flushed and
   309		// visible to a following GC. The uploader will automatically create a checkpoint every 45 minutes,
   310		// so ~1 hour should be enough but we're setting this to a higher conservative value for extra safety.
   311		MarginBetweenSnapshotGC time.Duration
   312	
   313		// RequireTwoGCCycles indicates that two GC cycles are required.
   314		RequireTwoGCCycles bool
   315	
   316		// DisableEventualConsistencySafety disables wait time to allow settling of eventually-consistent writes in blob stores.
   317		DisableEventualConsistencySafety bool
   318	
   319		// DropContentFromIndexExtraMargin is the amount of margin time before dropping deleted contents from indices.
   320		DropContentFromIndexExtraMargin time.Duration
   321	
   322		// Blob GC: Delete unused blobs above this age.
   323		PackDeleteMinAge time.Duration
   324	
   325		// Blob GC: Drop incomplete session blobs above this age.
   326		SessionExpirationAge time.Duration
   327	
   328		// Minimum time that must pass after content rewrite before we delete orphaned blobs.
   329		MinRewriteToOrphanDeletionDelay time.Duration
   330	}
   331	
   332	// Supported safety levels.
   333	//
   334	//nolint:gochecknoglobals
   335	var (
   336		// SafetyNone has safety parameters which allow full garbage collection without unnecessary
   337		// delays, but it is safe only if no other kopia clients are running and storage backend is
   338		// strongly consistent.
   339		SafetyNone = SafetyParameters{
   340			PackDeleteMinAge:                 0,
   341			DropContentFromIndexExtraMargin:  0,
   342			MarginBetweenSnapshotGC:          0,
   343			MinContentAgeSubjectToGC:         0,
   344			RewriteMinAge:                    0,
   345			SessionExpirationAge:             0,
   346			RequireTwoGCCycles:               false,
   347			DisableEventualConsistencySafety: true,
   348		}
   349	
   350		// SafetyFull has default safety parameters which allow safe GC concurrent with snapshotting
   351		// by other Kopia clients.
   352		SafetyFull = SafetyParameters{
   353			PackDeleteMinAge:                24 * time.Hour, //nolint:mnd
   354			DropContentFromIndexExtraMargin: time.Hour,
   355			MarginBetweenSnapshotGC:         4 * time.Hour,  //nolint:mnd
   356			MinContentAgeSubjectToGC:        24 * time.Hour, //nolint:mnd
   357			RewriteMinAge:                   2 * time.Hour,  //nolint:mnd
   358			SessionExpirationAge:            96 * time.Hour, //nolint:mnd
   359			RequireTwoGCCycles:              true,
   360			MinRewriteToOrphanDeletionDelay: time.Hour,
   361		}
   362	)

1	// Package maintenance manages automatic repository maintenance.
     2	package maintenance
     3	
     4	import (
     5		"context"
     6		"sort"
     7		"time"
     8	
     9		"github.com/gofrs/flock"
    10		"github.com/pkg/errors"
    11	
    12		"github.com/kopia/kopia/internal/clock"
    13		"github.com/kopia/kopia/internal/contentlog"
    14		"github.com/kopia/kopia/internal/contentlog/logparam"
    15		"github.com/kopia/kopia/internal/epoch"
    16		"github.com/kopia/kopia/repo"
    17		"github.com/kopia/kopia/repo/content"
    18		"github.com/kopia/kopia/repo/content/index"
    19		"github.com/kopia/kopia/repo/logging"
    20		"github.com/kopia/kopia/repo/maintenancestats"
    21	)
    22	
    23	// User-visible log output.
    24	var userLog = logging.Module("maintenance")
    25	
    26	const maxClockSkew = 5 * time.Minute
    27	
    28	// Mode describes the mode of maintenance to perform.
    29	type Mode string
    30	
    31	// Supported maintenance modes.
    32	const (
    33		ModeNone  Mode = "none"
    34		ModeQuick Mode = "quick"
    35		ModeFull  Mode = "full"
    36		ModeAuto  Mode = "auto" // run either quick of full if required by schedule
    37	)
    38	
    39	// TaskType identifies the type of a maintenance task.
    40	type TaskType string
    41	
    42	// Task IDs.
    43	const (
    44		TaskSnapshotGarbageCollection    = "snapshot-gc"
    45		TaskDeleteOrphanedBlobsQuick     = "quick-delete-blobs"
    46		TaskDeleteOrphanedBlobsFull      = "full-delete-blobs"
    47		TaskRewriteContentsQuick         = "quick-rewrite-contents"
    48		TaskRewriteContentsFull          = "full-rewrite-contents"
    49		TaskDropDeletedContentsFull      = "full-drop-deleted-content"
    50		TaskIndexCompaction              = "index-compaction"
    51		TaskExtendBlobRetentionTimeFull  = "extend-blob-retention-time"
    52		TaskCleanupLogs                  = "cleanup-logs"
    53		TaskEpochAdvance                 = "advance-epoch"
    54		TaskEpochDeleteSupersededIndexes = "delete-superseded-epoch-indexes"
    55		TaskEpochCleanupMarkers          = "cleanup-epoch-markers"
    56		TaskEpochGenerateRange           = "generate-epoch-range-index"
    57		TaskEpochCompactSingle           = "compact-single-epoch"
    58	)
    59	
    60	// shouldRun returns Mode if repository is due for periodic maintenance.
    61	func shouldRun(ctx context.Context, rep repo.DirectRepository, p *Params) (Mode, error) {
    62		if myUsername := rep.ClientOptions().UsernameAtHost(); p.Owner != myUsername {
    63			userLog(ctx).Debugf("maintenance owned by another user '%v'", p.Owner)
    64			return ModeNone, nil
    65		}
    66	
    67		s, err := GetSchedule(ctx, rep)
    68		if err != nil {
    69			return ModeNone, errors.Wrap(err, "error getting status")
    70		}
    71	
    72		// check full cycle first, as it does more than the quick cycle
    73		if p.FullCycle.Enabled {
    74			if !rep.Time().Before(s.NextFullMaintenanceTime) {
    75				userLog(ctx).Debug("due for full maintenance cycle")
    76				return ModeFull, nil
    77			}
    78	
    79			userLog(ctx).Debugf("not due for full maintenance cycle until %v", s.NextFullMaintenanceTime)
    80		} else {
    81			userLog(ctx).Debug("full maintenance cycle not enabled")
    82		}
    83	
    84		// no time for full cycle, check quick cycle
    85		if p.QuickCycle.Enabled {
    86			if !rep.Time().Before(s.NextQuickMaintenanceTime) {
    87				userLog(ctx).Debug("due for quick maintenance cycle")
    88				return ModeQuick, nil
    89			}
    90	
    91			userLog(ctx).Debugf("not due for quick maintenance cycle until %v", s.NextQuickMaintenanceTime)
    92		} else {
    93			userLog(ctx).Debug("quick maintenance cycle not enabled")
    94		}
    95	
    96		return ModeNone, nil
    97	}
    98	
    99	func updateSchedule(ctx context.Context, runParams RunParameters) error {
   100		rep := runParams.rep
   101		p := runParams.Params
   102	
   103		s, err := GetSchedule(ctx, rep)
   104		if err != nil {
   105			return errors.Wrap(err, "error getting schedule")
   106		}
   107	
   108		switch runParams.Mode {
   109		case ModeFull:
   110			// on full cycle, also update the quick cycle
   111			s.NextFullMaintenanceTime = rep.Time().Add(p.FullCycle.Interval)
   112			s.NextQuickMaintenanceTime = rep.Time().Add(p.QuickCycle.Interval)
   113			userLog(ctx).Debugf("scheduling next full cycle at %v", s.NextFullMaintenanceTime)
   114			userLog(ctx).Debugf("scheduling next quick cycle at %v", s.NextQuickMaintenanceTime)
   115	
   116			return SetSchedule(ctx, rep, s)
   117	
   118		case ModeQuick:
   119			userLog(ctx).Debugf("scheduling next quick cycle at %v", s.NextQuickMaintenanceTime)
   120			s.NextQuickMaintenanceTime = rep.Time().Add(p.QuickCycle.Interval)
   121	
   122			return SetSchedule(ctx, rep, s)
   123	
   124		default:
   125			return nil
   126		}
   127	}
   128	
   129	// RunParameters passes essential parameters for maintenance.
   130	// It is generated by RunExclusive and can't be create outside of its package and
   131	// is required to ensure all maintenance tasks run under an exclusive lock.
   132	type RunParameters struct {
   133		rep repo.DirectRepositoryWriter
   134	
   135		Mode Mode
   136	
   137		Params *Params
   138	
   139		// timestamp of the last update of maintenance schedule blob
   140		MaintenanceStartTime time.Time
   141	}
   142	
   143	// NotOwnedError is returned when maintenance cannot run because it is owned by another user.
   144	type NotOwnedError struct {
   145		Owner string
   146	}
   147	
   148	func (e NotOwnedError) Error() string {
   149		return "maintenance must be run by designated user: " + e.Owner
   150	}
   151	
   152	// RunExclusive runs the provided callback if the maintenance is owned by local user and
   153	// lock can be acquired. Lock is passed to the function, which ensures that every call to Run()
   154	// is within the exclusive context.
   155	func RunExclusive(ctx context.Context, rep repo.DirectRepositoryWriter, mode Mode, force bool, cb func(ctx context.Context, runParams RunParameters) error) error {
   156		ctx = contentlog.WithParams(ctx,
   157			logparam.String("span:maintenance", contentlog.RandomSpanID()))
   158	
   159		rep.DisableIndexRefresh()
   160	
   161		p, err := GetParams(ctx, rep)
   162		if err != nil {
   163			return errors.Wrap(err, "unable to get maintenance params")
   164		}
   165	
   166		if !force && !p.isOwnedByByThisUser(rep) {
   167			return NotOwnedError{p.Owner}
   168		}
   169	
   170		if mode == ModeAuto {
   171			mode, err = shouldRun(ctx, rep, p)
   172			if err != nil {
   173				return errors.Wrap(err, "unable to determine if maintenance is required")
   174			}
   175		}
   176	
   177		if mode == ModeNone {
   178			userLog(ctx).Debug("not due for maintenance")
   179			return nil
   180		}
   181	
   182		lockFile := rep.ConfigFilename() + ".mlock"
   183		userLog(ctx).Debugf("Acquiring maintenance lock in file %v", lockFile)
   184	
   185		// acquire local lock on a config file
   186		l := flock.New(lockFile)
   187	
   188		ok, err := l.TryLock()
   189		if err != nil {
   190			return errors.Wrap(err, "error acquiring maintenance lock")
   191		}
   192	
   193		if !ok {
   194			userLog(ctx).Debug("maintenance is already in progress locally")
   195			return nil
   196		}
   197	
   198		defer l.Unlock() //nolint:errcheck
   199	
   200		runParams := RunParameters{rep, mode, p, time.Time{}}
   201	
   202		// update schedule so that we don't run the maintenance again immediately if
   203		// this process crashes.
   204		if err = updateSchedule(ctx, runParams); err != nil {
   205			return errors.Wrap(err, "error updating maintenance schedule")
   206		}
   207	
   208		bm, err := runParams.rep.BlobReader().GetMetadata(ctx, maintenanceScheduleBlobID)
   209		if err != nil {
   210			return errors.Wrap(err, "error getting maintenance blob time")
   211		}
   212	
   213		runParams.MaintenanceStartTime = bm.Timestamp
   214	
   215		if err = checkClockSkewBounds(runParams); err != nil {
   216			return errors.Wrap(err, "error checking for clock skew")
   217		}
   218	
   219		userLog(ctx).Infof("Running %v maintenance...", runParams.Mode)
   220		defer userLog(ctx).Infof("Finished %v maintenance.", runParams.Mode)
   221	
   222		if err := runParams.rep.Refresh(ctx); err != nil {
   223			return errors.Wrap(err, "error refreshing indexes before maintenance")
   224		}
   225	
   226		return cb(ctx, runParams)
   227	}
   228	
   229	func checkClockSkewBounds(rp RunParameters) error {
   230		localTime := rp.rep.Time()
   231		repoTime := rp.MaintenanceStartTime
   232	
   233		clockSkew := repoTime.Sub(localTime)
   234		if clockSkew < 0 {
   235			clockSkew = -clockSkew
   236		}
   237	
   238		if clockSkew > maxClockSkew {
   239			return errors.Errorf("clock skew detected: local clock is out of sync with repository timestamp by more than allowed %v (local: %v repository: %v skew: %s). Refusing to run maintenance.", maxClockSkew, localTime, repoTime, clockSkew) //nolint:revive
   240		}
   241	
   242		return nil
   243	}
   244	
   245	// Run performs maintenance activities for a repository.
   246	func Run(ctx context.Context, runParams RunParameters, safety SafetyParameters) error {
   247		switch runParams.Mode {
   248		case ModeQuick:
   249			return runQuickMaintenance(ctx, runParams, safety)
   250	
   251		case ModeFull:
   252			return runFullMaintenance(ctx, runParams, safety)
   253	
   254		default:
   255			return errors.Errorf("unknown mode %q", runParams.Mode)
   256		}
   257	}
   258	
   259	func runQuickMaintenance(ctx context.Context, runParams RunParameters, safety SafetyParameters) error {
   260		log := runParams.rep.LogManager().NewLogger("maintenance-quick")
   261	
   262		s, err := GetSchedule(ctx, runParams.rep)
   263		if err != nil {
   264			return errors.Wrap(err, "unable to get schedule")
   265		}
   266	
   267		em, ok, emerr := runParams.rep.ContentManager().EpochManager(ctx)
   268		if ok {
   269			userLog(ctx).Debug("running quick epoch maintenance only")
   270	
   271			return runTaskEpochMaintenanceQuick(ctx, em, runParams, s)
   272		}
   273	
   274		if emerr != nil {
   275			return errors.Wrap(emerr, "epoch manager")
   276		}
   277	
   278		if shouldQuickRewriteContents(s, safety) {
   279			// find 'q' packs that are less than 80% full and rewrite contents in them into
   280			// new consolidated packs, orphaning old packs in the process.
   281			if err := runTaskRewriteContentsQuick(ctx, runParams, s, safety); err != nil {
   282				return errors.Wrap(err, "error rewriting metadata contents")
   283			}
   284		} else {
   285			notRewritingContents(ctx, log)
   286		}
   287	
   288		if shouldDeleteOrphanedPacks(runParams.rep.Time(), s, safety) {
   289			var err error
   290	
   291			// time to delete orphaned blobs after last rewrite,
   292			// if the last rewrite was full (started as part of full maintenance) we must complete it by
   293			// running full orphaned blob deletion, otherwise next quick maintenance will start a quick rewrite
   294			// and we'd never delete blobs orphaned by full rewrite.
   295			if hadRecentFullRewrite(s) {
   296				userLog(ctx).Debug("Had recent full rewrite - performing full pack deletion.")
   297				err = runTaskDeleteOrphanedPacksFull(ctx, runParams, s, safety)
   298			} else {
   299				userLog(ctx).Debug("Performing quick pack deletion.")
   300				err = runTaskDeleteOrphanedPacksQuick(ctx, runParams, s, safety)
   301			}
   302	
   303			if err != nil {
   304				return errors.Wrap(err, "error deleting unreferenced metadata packs")
   305			}
   306		} else {
   307			notDeletingOrphanedPacks(ctx, log, s, safety)
   308		}
   309	
   310		// consolidate many smaller indexes into fewer larger ones.
   311		if err := runTaskIndexCompactionQuick(contentlog.WithParams(ctx, logparam.String("span:index-compaction", contentlog.RandomSpanID())), runParams, s, safety); err != nil {
   312			return errors.Wrap(err, "error performing index compaction")
   313		}
   314	
   315		// clean up logs last
   316		if err := runTaskCleanupLogs(contentlog.WithParams(ctx, logparam.String("span:cleanup-logs", contentlog.RandomSpanID())), runParams, s); err != nil {
   317			return errors.Wrap(err, "error cleaning up logs")
   318		}
   319	
   320		return nil
   321	}
   322	
   323	func notRewritingContents(ctx context.Context, log *contentlog.Logger) {
   324		contentlog.Log(ctx, log, "Previous content rewrite has not been finalized yet, waiting until the next blob deletion.")
   325	}
   326	
   327	func notDeletingOrphanedPacks(ctx context.Context, log *contentlog.Logger, s *Schedule, safety SafetyParameters) {
   328		left := nextPackDeleteTime(s, safety).Sub(clock.Now()).Truncate(time.Second)
   329	
   330		contentlog.Log1(ctx, log, "Skipping pack deletion because not enough time has passed yet", logparam.Duration("left", left))
   331	}
   332	
   333	func runTaskCleanupLogs(ctx context.Context, runParams RunParameters, s *Schedule) error {
   334		return ReportRun(ctx, runParams.rep, TaskCleanupLogs, s, func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error) {
   335			stats, err := CleanupLogs(ctx, runParams.rep, runParams.Params.LogRetention.OrDefault())
   336	
   337			var deletedLogCount uint64
   338			if stats != nil {
   339				deletedLogCount = stats.DeletedBlobCount
   340			}
   341	
   342			userLog(ctx).Infof("Cleaned up %v logs.", deletedLogCount)
   343	
   344			return stats, err
   345		})
   346	}
   347	
   348	func runTaskEpochAdvance(ctx context.Context, em *epoch.Manager, runParams RunParameters, s *Schedule) error {
   349		return reportRunAndMaybeCheckContentIndex(ctx, runParams.rep, TaskEpochAdvance, s, func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error) {
   350			userLog(ctx).Info("Advancing epoch markers...")
   351	
   352			stats, err := em.MaybeAdvanceWriteEpoch(ctx)
   353	
   354			return stats, errors.Wrap(err, "error advancing epoch marker")
   355		})
   356	}
   357	
   358	func runTaskEpochMaintenanceQuick(ctx context.Context, em *epoch.Manager, runParams RunParameters, s *Schedule) error {
   359		err := reportRunAndMaybeCheckContentIndex(ctx, runParams.rep, TaskEpochCompactSingle, s, func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error) {
   360			userLog(ctx).Info("Compacting an eligible uncompacted epoch...")
   361	
   362			stats, err := em.MaybeCompactSingleEpoch(ctx)
   363	
   364			return stats, errors.Wrap(err, "error compacting single epoch")
   365		})
   366		if err != nil {
   367			return err
   368		}
   369	
   370		err = runTaskEpochAdvance(ctx, em, runParams, s)
   371	
   372		return errors.Wrap(err, "error to advance epoch in quick epoch maintenance task")
   373	}
   374	
   375	func runTaskEpochMaintenanceFull(ctx context.Context, runParams RunParameters, s *Schedule) error {
   376		em, hasEpochManager, emerr := runParams.rep.ContentManager().EpochManager(ctx)
   377		if emerr != nil {
   378			return errors.Wrap(emerr, "epoch manager")
   379		}
   380	
   381		if !hasEpochManager {
   382			return nil
   383		}
   384	
   385		// compact a single epoch
   386		if err := reportRunAndMaybeCheckContentIndex(ctx, runParams.rep, TaskEpochCompactSingle, s, func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error) {
   387			userLog(ctx).Info("Compacting an eligible uncompacted epoch...")
   388	
   389			stats, err := em.MaybeCompactSingleEpoch(ctx)
   390	
   391			return stats, errors.Wrap(err, "error compacting single epoch")
   392		}); err != nil {
   393			return err
   394		}
   395	
   396		if err := runTaskEpochAdvance(ctx, em, runParams, s); err != nil {
   397			return err
   398		}
   399	
   400		// compact range
   401		if err := reportRunAndMaybeCheckContentIndex(ctx, runParams.rep, TaskEpochGenerateRange, s, func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error) {
   402			userLog(ctx).Info("Attempting to compact a range of epoch indexes ...")
   403	
   404			stats, err := em.MaybeGenerateRangeCheckpoint(ctx)
   405	
   406			return stats, errors.Wrap(err, "error creating epoch range indexes")
   407		}); err != nil {
   408			return err
   409		}
   410	
   411		// clean up epoch markers
   412		err := ReportRun(ctx, runParams.rep, TaskEpochCleanupMarkers, s, func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error) {
   413			userLog(ctx).Info("Cleaning up unneeded epoch markers...")
   414	
   415			stats, err := em.CleanupMarkers(ctx)
   416	
   417			return stats, errors.Wrap(err, "error removing epoch markers")
   418		})
   419		if err != nil {
   420			return err
   421		}
   422	
   423		return reportRunAndMaybeCheckContentIndex(ctx, runParams.rep, TaskEpochDeleteSupersededIndexes, s, func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error) {
   424			userLog(ctx).Info("Cleaning up old index blobs which have already been compacted...")
   425	
   426			stats, err := em.CleanupSupersededIndexes(ctx)
   427	
   428			return stats, errors.Wrap(err, "error removing superseded epoch index blobs")
   429		})
   430	}
   431	
   432	func runTaskDropDeletedContentsFull(ctx context.Context, runParams RunParameters, s *Schedule, safety SafetyParameters) error {
   433		var safeDropTime time.Time
   434	
   435		log := runParams.rep.LogManager().NewLogger("maintenance-drop-deleted-contents")
   436	
   437		if safety.RequireTwoGCCycles {
   438			safeDropTime = findSafeDropTime(s.Runs[TaskSnapshotGarbageCollection], safety)
   439		} else {
   440			safeDropTime = runParams.rep.Time()
   441		}
   442	
   443		if safeDropTime.IsZero() {
   444			contentlog.Log(ctx, log,
   445				"Not forgetting deleted contents yet since not enough time has passed since previous successful Snapshot GC. Will try again next time.")
   446	
   447			return nil
   448		}
   449	
   450		contentlog.Log1(ctx, log, "Found safe time to drop indexes", logparam.Time("safeDropTime", safeDropTime))
   451	
   452		return reportRunAndMaybeCheckContentIndex(ctx, runParams.rep, TaskDropDeletedContentsFull, s, func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error) {
   453			return dropDeletedContents(ctx, runParams.rep, safeDropTime, safety)
   454		})
   455	}
   456	
   457	func runTaskRewriteContentsQuick(ctx context.Context, runParams RunParameters, s *Schedule, safety SafetyParameters) error {
   458		return reportRunAndMaybeCheckContentIndex(ctx, runParams.rep, TaskRewriteContentsQuick, s, func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error) {
   459			return RewriteContents(ctx, runParams.rep, &RewriteContentsOptions{
   460				ContentIDRange: index.AllPrefixedIDs,
   461				PackPrefix:     content.PackBlobIDPrefixSpecial,
   462				ShortPacks:     true,
   463			}, safety)
   464		})
   465	}
   466	
   467	func runTaskRewriteContentsFull(ctx context.Context, runParams RunParameters, s *Schedule, safety SafetyParameters) error {

   501	func runFullMaintenance(ctx context.Context, runParams RunParameters, safety SafetyParameters) error {
   502		log := runParams.rep.LogManager().NewLogger("maintenance-full")
   503	
   504		s, err := GetSchedule(ctx, runParams.rep)
   505		if err != nil {
   506			return errors.Wrap(err, "unable to get schedule")
   507		}
   508	
   509		if shouldFullRewriteContents(s, safety) {
   510			// find packs that are less than 80% full and rewrite contents in them into
   511			// new consolidated packs, orphaning old packs in the process.
   512			if err := runTaskRewriteContentsFull(ctx, runParams, s, safety); err != nil {
   513				return errors.Wrap(err, "error rewriting contents in short packs")
   514			}
   515		} else {
   516			notRewritingContents(ctx, log)
   517		}
   518	
   519		// rewrite indexes by dropping content entries that have been marked
   520		// as deleted for a long time
   521		if err := runTaskDropDeletedContentsFull(ctx, runParams, s, safety); err != nil {
   522			return errors.Wrap(err, "error dropping deleted contents")
   523		}
   524	
   525		if shouldDeleteOrphanedPacks(runParams.rep.Time(), s, safety) {
   526			// delete orphaned packs after some time.
   527			if err := runTaskDeleteOrphanedPacksFull(ctx, runParams, s, safety); err != nil {
   528				return errors.Wrap(err, "error deleting unreferenced blobs")
   529			}
   530		} else {
   531			notDeletingOrphanedPacks(ctx, log, s, safety)
   532		}
   533	
   534		// extend retention-time on supported storage.
   535		if runParams.Params.ExtendObjectLocks {
   536			if err := runTaskExtendBlobRetentionTimeFull(ctx, runParams, s); err != nil {
   537				return errors.Wrap(err, "error extending object lock retention time")
   538			}
   539		} else {
   540			userLog(ctx).Debug("Extending object lock retention-period is disabled.")
   541		}
   542	
   543		if err := runTaskEpochMaintenanceFull(ctx, runParams, s); err != nil {
   544			return errors.Wrap(err, "error cleaning up epoch manager")
   545		}
   546	
   547		// clean up logs last
   548		if err := runTaskCleanupLogs(ctx, runParams, s); err != nil {
   549			return errors.Wrap(err, "error cleaning up logs")
   550		}
   551	
   552		return nil
   553	}

   555	// shouldQuickRewriteContents returns true if it's currently ok to rewrite contents.
   556	// since each content rewrite will require deleting of orphaned blobs after some time passes,
   557	// we don't want to starve blob deletion by constantly doing rewrites.
   558	func shouldQuickRewriteContents(s *Schedule, safety SafetyParameters) bool {
   559		latestContentRewriteEndTime := maxEndTime(s.Runs[TaskRewriteContentsFull], s.Runs[TaskRewriteContentsQuick])
   560		latestBlobDeleteTime := maxEndTime(s.Runs[TaskDeleteOrphanedBlobsFull], s.Runs[TaskDeleteOrphanedBlobsQuick])
   561	
   562		// never did rewrite - safe to do so.
   563		if latestContentRewriteEndTime.IsZero() || safety.MinRewriteToOrphanDeletionDelay == 0 {
   564			return true
   565		}
   566	
   567		return !latestBlobDeleteTime.Before(latestContentRewriteEndTime)
   568	}
   569	
   570	// shouldFullRewriteContents returns true if it's currently ok to rewrite contents.
   571	// since each content rewrite will require deleting of orphaned blobs after some time passes,
   572	// we don't want to starve blob deletion by constantly doing rewrites.
   573	func shouldFullRewriteContents(s *Schedule, safety SafetyParameters) bool {
   574		// NOTE - we're not looking at TaskRewriteContentsQuick here, this allows full rewrite to sometimes
   575		// follow quick rewrite.
   576		latestContentRewriteEndTime := maxEndTime(s.Runs[TaskRewriteContentsFull])
   577		latestBlobDeleteTime := maxEndTime(s.Runs[TaskDeleteOrphanedBlobsFull], s.Runs[TaskDeleteOrphanedBlobsQuick])
   578	
   579		// never did rewrite - safe to do so.
   580		if latestContentRewriteEndTime.IsZero() || safety.MinRewriteToOrphanDeletionDelay == 0 {
   581			return true
   582		}
   583	
   584		return !latestBlobDeleteTime.Before(latestContentRewriteEndTime)
   585	}
   586	
   587	// shouldDeleteOrphanedPacks returns true if it's ok to delete orphaned packs.
   588	// it is only safe to do so after >1hr since the last content rewrite finished to ensure
   589	// other clients refresh their indexes.
   590	// rewritten packs become orphaned immediately but if we don't wait before their deletion
   591	// clients who have old indexes cached may be trying to read pre-rewrite blobs.
   592	func shouldDeleteOrphanedPacks(now time.Time, s *Schedule, safety SafetyParameters) bool {
   593		return !now.Before(nextPackDeleteTime(s, safety))
   594	}
   595	
   596	func nextPackDeleteTime(s *Schedule, safety SafetyParameters) time.Time {
   597		latestContentRewriteEndTime := maxEndTime(s.Runs[TaskRewriteContentsFull], s.Runs[TaskRewriteContentsQuick])
   598		if latestContentRewriteEndTime.IsZero() {
   599			return time.Time{}
   600		}
   601	
   602		return latestContentRewriteEndTime.Add(safety.MinRewriteToOrphanDeletionDelay)
   603	}
   604	
   605	func hadRecentFullRewrite(s *Schedule) bool {
   606		return !maxEndTime(s.Runs[TaskRewriteContentsFull]).Before(maxEndTime(s.Runs[TaskRewriteContentsQuick]))
   607	}
   608	
   609	func maxEndTime(taskRuns ...[]RunInfo) time.Time {
   610		var result time.Time
   611	
   612		for _, tr := range taskRuns {
   613			for _, r := range tr {
   614				if !r.Success {
   615					continue
   616				}
   617	
   618				if r.End.After(result) {
   619					result = r.End
   620				}
   621			}
   622		}
   623	
   624		return result
   625	}
   626	
   627	// findSafeDropTime returns the latest timestamp for which it is safe to drop content entries
   628	// deleted before that time, because at least two successful GC cycles have completed
   629	// and minimum required time between the GCs has passed.
   630	//
   631	// The worst possible case we need to handle is:
   632	//
   633	// Step #1 - race between GC and snapshot creation:
   634	//
   635	//   - 'snapshot gc' runs and marks unreachable contents as deleted
   636	//   - 'snapshot create' runs at approximately the same time and creates manifest
   637	//     which makes some contents live again.
   638	//
   639	// As a result of this race, GC has marked some entries as incorrectly deleted, but we
   640	// can still return them since they are not dropped from the index.
   641	//
   642	// Step #2 - fix incorrectly deleted contents
   643	//
   644	//   - subsequent 'snapshot gc' runs and undeletes contents incorrectly
   645	//     marked as deleted in Step 1.
   646	//
   647	// After Step 2 completes, we know for sure that all contents deleted before Step #1 has started
   648	// are safe to drop from the index because Step #2 has fixed them, as long as all snapshots that
   649	// were racing with snapshot GC in step #1 have flushed pending writes, hence the
   650	// safety.MarginBetweenSnapshotGC.
   651	func findSafeDropTime(runs []RunInfo, safety SafetyParameters) time.Time {
   652		var successfulRuns []RunInfo
   653	
   654		for _, r := range runs {
   655			if r.Success {
   656				successfulRuns = append(successfulRuns, r)
   657			}
   658		}
   659	
   660		if len(successfulRuns) <= 1 {
   661			return time.Time{}
   662		}
   663	
   664		// sort so that successfulRuns[0] is the latest
   665		sort.Slice(successfulRuns, func(i, j int) bool {
   666			return successfulRuns[i].Start.After(successfulRuns[j].Start)
   667		})
   668	
   669		// Look for previous successful run such that the time between GCs exceeds the safety margin.
   670		for _, r := range successfulRuns[1:] {
   671			diff := -r.End.Sub(successfulRuns[0].Start)
   672			if diff > safety.MarginBetweenSnapshotGC {
   673				return r.Start.Add(-safety.DropContentFromIndexExtraMargin)
   674			}
   675		}
   676	
   677		return time.Time{}
   678	}

    60	// shouldRun returns Mode if repository is due for periodic maintenance.
    61	func shouldRun(ctx context.Context, rep repo.DirectRepository, p *Params) (Mode, error) {
    62		if myUsername := rep.ClientOptions().UsernameAtHost(); p.Owner != myUsername {
    63			userLog(ctx).Debugf("maintenance owned by another user '%v'", p.Owner)
    64			return ModeNone, nil
    65		}
    66	
    67		s, err := GetSchedule(ctx, rep)
    68		if err != nil {
    69			return ModeNone, errors.Wrap(err, "error getting status")
    70		}
    71	
    72		// check full cycle first, as it does more than the quick cycle
    73		if p.FullCycle.Enabled {
    74			if !rep.Time().Before(s.NextFullMaintenanceTime) {
    75				userLog(ctx).Debug("due for full maintenance cycle")
    76				return ModeFull, nil
    77			}
    78	
    79			userLog(ctx).Debugf("not due for full maintenance cycle until %v", s.NextFullMaintenanceTime)
    80		} else {
    81			userLog(ctx).Debug("full maintenance cycle not enabled")
    82		}
    83	
    84		// no time for full cycle, check quick cycle
    85		if p.QuickCycle.Enabled {
    86			if !rep.Time().Before(s.NextQuickMaintenanceTime) {
    87				userLog(ctx).Debug("due for quick maintenance cycle")
    88				return ModeQuick, nil
    89			}
    90	
    91			userLog(ctx).Debugf("not due for quick maintenance cycle until %v", s.NextQuickMaintenanceTime)
    92		} else {
    93			userLog(ctx).Debug("quick maintenance cycle not enabled")
    94		}
    95	
    96		return ModeNone, nil
    97	}

    99	func updateSchedule(ctx context.Context, runParams RunParameters) error {
   100		rep := runParams.rep
   101		p := runParams.Params
   102	
   103		s, err := GetSchedule(ctx, rep)
   104		if err != nil {
   105			return errors.Wrap(err, "error getting schedule")
   106		}
   107	
   108		switch runParams.Mode {
   109		case ModeFull:
   110			// on full cycle, also update the quick cycle
   111			s.NextFullMaintenanceTime = rep.Time().Add(p.FullCycle.Interval)
   112			s.NextQuickMaintenanceTime = rep.Time().Add(p.QuickCycle.Interval)
   113			userLog(ctx).Debugf("scheduling next full cycle at %v", s.NextFullMaintenanceTime)
   114			userLog(ctx).Debugf("scheduling next quick cycle at %v", s.NextQuickMaintenanceTime)
   115	
   116			return SetSchedule(ctx, rep, s)
   117	
   118		case ModeQuick:
   119			userLog(ctx).Debugf("scheduling next quick cycle at %v", s.NextQuickMaintenanceTime)
   120			s.NextQuickMaintenanceTime = rep.Time().Add(p.QuickCycle.Interval)
   121	
   122			return SetSchedule(ctx, rep, s)
   123	
   124		default:
   125			return nil
   126		}
   127	}

   129	// RunParameters passes essential parameters for maintenance.
   130	// It is generated by RunExclusive and can't be create outside of its package and
   131	// is required to ensure all maintenance tasks run under an exclusive lock.
   132	type RunParameters struct {
   133		rep repo.DirectRepositoryWriter
   134	
   135		Mode Mode
   136	
   137		Params *Params
   138	
   139		// timestamp of the last update of maintenance schedule blob
   140		MaintenanceStartTime time.Time
   141	}
   142	
   143	// NotOwnedError is returned when maintenance cannot run because it is owned by another user.
   144	type NotOwnedError struct {
   145		Owner string
   146	}
   147	
   148	func (e NotOwnedError) Error() string {
   149		return "maintenance must be run by designated user: " + e.Owner
   150	}
   151	
   152	// RunExclusive runs the provided callback if the maintenance is owned by local user and
   153	// lock can be acquired. Lock is passed to the function, which ensures that every call to Run()
   154	// is within the exclusive context.
   155	func RunExclusive(ctx context.Context, rep repo.DirectRepositoryWriter, mode Mode, force bool, cb func(ctx context.Context, runParams RunParameters) error) error {
   156		ctx = contentlog.WithParams(ctx,
   157			logparam.String("span:maintenance", contentlog.RandomSpanID()))
   158	
   159		rep.DisableIndexRefresh()
   160	
   161		p, err := GetParams(ctx, rep)
   162		if err != nil {
   163			return errors.Wrap(err, "unable to get maintenance params")
   164		}
   165	
   166		if !force && !p.isOwnedByByThisUser(rep) {
   167			return NotOwnedError{p.Owner}
   168		}
   169	
   170		if mode == ModeAuto {
   171			mode, err = shouldRun(ctx, rep, p)
   172			if err != nil {
   173				return errors.Wrap(err, "unable to determine if maintenance is required")
   174			}
   175		}
   176	
   177		if mode == ModeNone {
   178			userLog(ctx).Debug("not due for maintenance")
   179			return nil
   180		}
   181	
   182		lockFile := rep.ConfigFilename() + ".mlock"
   183		userLog(ctx).Debugf("Acquiring maintenance lock in file %v", lockFile)
   184	
   185		// acquire local lock on a config file
   186		l := flock.New(lockFile)
   187	
   188		ok, err := l.TryLock()
   189		if err != nil {
   190			return errors.Wrap(err, "error acquiring maintenance lock")
   191		}
   192	
   193		if !ok {
   194			userLog(ctx).Debug("maintenance is already in progress locally")
   195			return nil
   196		}
   197	
   198		defer l.Unlock() //nolint:errcheck
   199	
   200		runParams := RunParameters{rep, mode, p, time.Time{}}
   201	
   202		// update schedule so that we don't run the maintenance again immediately if
   203		// this process crashes.
   204		if err = updateSchedule(ctx, runParams); err != nil {
   205			return errors.Wrap(err, "error updating maintenance schedule")
   206		}
   207	
   208		bm, err := runParams.rep.BlobReader().GetMetadata(ctx, maintenanceScheduleBlobID)
   209		if err != nil {
   210			return errors.Wrap(err, "error getting maintenance blob time")
   211		}
   212	
   213		runParams.MaintenanceStartTime = bm.Timestamp
   214	
   215		if err = checkClockSkewBounds(runParams); err != nil {
   216			return errors.Wrap(err, "error checking for clock skew")
   217		}
   218	
   219		userLog(ctx).Infof("Running %v maintenance...", runParams.Mode)
   220		defer userLog(ctx).Infof("Finished %v maintenance.", runParams.Mode)
   221	
   222		if err := runParams.rep.Refresh(ctx); err != nil {
   223			return errors.Wrap(err, "error refreshing indexes before maintenance")
   224		}
   225	
   226		return cb(ctx, runParams)
   227	}

   229	func checkClockSkewBounds(rp RunParameters) error {
   230		localTime := rp.rep.Time()
   231		repoTime := rp.MaintenanceStartTime
   232	
   233		clockSkew := repoTime.Sub(localTime)
   234		if clockSkew < 0 {
   235			clockSkew = -clockSkew
   236		}
   237	
   238		if clockSkew > maxClockSkew {
   239			return errors.Errorf("clock skew detected: local clock is out of sync with repository timestamp by more than allowed %v (local: %v repository: %v skew: %s). Refusing to run maintenance.", maxClockSkew, localTime, repoTime, clockSkew) //nolint:revive
   240		}
   241	
   242		return nil
   243	}

   245	// Run performs maintenance activities for a repository.
   246	func Run(ctx context.Context, runParams RunParameters, safety SafetyParameters) error {
   247		switch runParams.Mode {
   248		case ModeQuick:
   249			return runQuickMaintenance(ctx, runParams, safety)
   250	
   251		case ModeFull:
   252			return runFullMaintenance(ctx, runParams, safety)
   253	
   254		default:
   255			return errors.Errorf("unknown mode %q", runParams.Mode)
   256		}
   257	}

   259	func runQuickMaintenance(ctx context.Context, runParams RunParameters, safety SafetyParameters) error {
   260		log := runParams.rep.LogManager().NewLogger("maintenance-quick")
   261	
   262		s, err := GetSchedule(ctx, runParams.rep)
   263		if err != nil {
   264			return errors.Wrap(err, "unable to get schedule")
   265		}
   266	
   267		em, ok, emerr := runParams.rep.ContentManager().EpochManager(ctx)
   268		if ok {
   269			userLog(ctx).Debug("running quick epoch maintenance only")
   270	
   271			return runTaskEpochMaintenanceQuick(ctx, em, runParams, s)
   272		}
   273	
   274		if emerr != nil {
   275			return errors.Wrap(emerr, "epoch manager")
   276		}
   277	
   278		if shouldQuickRewriteContents(s, safety) {
   279			// find 'q' packs that are less than 80% full and rewrite contents in them into
   280			// new consolidated packs, orphaning old packs in the process.
   281			if err := runTaskRewriteContentsQuick(ctx, runParams, s, safety); err != nil {
   282				return errors.Wrap(err, "error rewriting metadata contents")
   283			}
   284		} else {
   285			notRewritingContents(ctx, log)
   286		}
   287	
   288		if shouldDeleteOrphanedPacks(runParams.rep.Time(), s, safety) {
   289			var err error
   290	
   291			// time to delete orphaned blobs after last rewrite,
   292			// if the last rewrite was full (started as part of full maintenance) we must complete it by
   293			// running full orphaned blob deletion, otherwise next quick maintenance will start a quick rewrite
   294			// and we'd never delete blobs orphaned by full rewrite.
   295			if hadRecentFullRewrite(s) {
   296				userLog(ctx).Debug("Had recent full rewrite - performing full pack deletion.")
   297				err = runTaskDeleteOrphanedPacksFull(ctx, runParams, s, safety)
   298			} else {
   299				userLog(ctx).Debug("Performing quick pack deletion.")
   300				err = runTaskDeleteOrphanedPacksQuick(ctx, runParams, s, safety)
   301			}
   302	
   303			if err != nil {
   304				return errors.Wrap(err, "error deleting unreferenced metadata packs")
   305			}
   306		} else {
   307			notDeletingOrphanedPacks(ctx, log, s, safety)
   308		}
   309	
   310		// consolidate many smaller indexes into fewer larger ones.
   311		if err := runTaskIndexCompactionQuick(contentlog.WithParams(ctx, logparam.String("span:index-compaction", contentlog.RandomSpanID())), runParams, s, safety); err != nil {
   312			return errors.Wrap(err, "error performing index compaction")
   313		}
   314	
   315		// clean up logs last
   316		if err := runTaskCleanupLogs(contentlog.WithParams(ctx, logparam.String("span:cleanup-logs", contentlog.RandomSpanID())), runParams, s); err != nil {
   317			return errors.Wrap(err, "error cleaning up logs")
   318		}
   319	
   320		return nil
   321	}
   322	
   323	func notRewritingContents(ctx context.Context, log *contentlog.Logger) {
   324		contentlog.Log(ctx, log, "Previous content rewrite has not been finalized yet, waiting until the next blob deletion.")
   325	}
   326	
   327	func notDeletingOrphanedPacks(ctx context.Context, log *contentlog.Logger, s *Schedule, safety SafetyParameters) {
   328		left := nextPackDeleteTime(s, safety).Sub(clock.Now()).Truncate(time.Second)
   329	
   330		contentlog.Log1(ctx, log, "Skipping pack deletion because not enough time has passed yet", logparam.Duration("left", left))
   331	}

   333	func runTaskCleanupLogs(ctx context.Context, runParams RunParameters, s *Schedule) error {
   334		return ReportRun(ctx, runParams.rep, TaskCleanupLogs, s, func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error) {
   335			stats, err := CleanupLogs(ctx, runParams.rep, runParams.Params.LogRetention.OrDefault())
   336	
   337			var deletedLogCount uint64
   338			if stats != nil {
   339				deletedLogCount = stats.DeletedBlobCount
   340			}
   341	
   342			userLog(ctx).Infof("Cleaned up %v logs.", deletedLogCount)

   376		em, hasEpochManager, emerr := runParams.rep.ContentManager().EpochManager(ctx)
   377		if emerr != nil {

   392		}); err != nil {

   395	
   396		if err := runTaskEpochAdvance(ctx, em, runParams, s); err != nil {

   398		}

   400		// compact range
   401		if err := reportRunAndMaybeCheckContentIndex(ctx, runParams.rep, TaskEpochGenerateRange, s, func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error) {
   402			userLog(ctx).Info("Attempting to compact a range of epoch indexes ...")
   403	
   404			stats, err := em.MaybeGenerateRangeCheckpoint(ctx)
   405	
   406			return stats, errors.Wrap(err, "error creating epoch range indexes")
   407		}); err != nil {

   409		}
   410	
   411		// clean up epoch markers
   412		err := ReportRun(ctx, runParams.rep, TaskEpochCleanupMarkers, s, func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error) {

   414	
   415			stats, err := em.CleanupMarkers(ctx)

   417			return stats, errors.Wrap(err, "error removing epoch markers")
   418		})

   421		}

   424			userLog(ctx).Info("Cleaning up old index blobs which have already been compacted...")
   425

   429		})

   432	func runTaskDropDeletedContentsFull(ctx context.Context, runParams RunParameters, s *Schedule, safety SafetyParameters) error {
   433		var safeDropTime time.Time
   434	
   435		log := runParams.rep.LogManager().NewLogger("maintenance-drop-deleted-contents")
   436	
   437		if safety.RequireTwoGCCycles {
   438			safeDropTime = findSafeDropTime(s.Runs[TaskSnapshotGarbageCollection], safety)
   439		} else {
   440			safeDropTime = runParams.rep.Time()
   441		}
   442	
   443		if safeDropTime.IsZero() {
   444			contentlog.Log(ctx, log,
   445				"Not forgetting deleted contents yet since not enough time has passed since previous successful Snapshot GC. Will try again next time.")
   446	
   447			return nil
   448		}
   449	
   450		contentlog.Log1(ctx, log, "Found safe time to drop indexes", logparam.Time("safeDropTime", safeDropTime))
   451	
   452		return reportRunAndMaybeCheckContentIndex(ctx, runParams.rep, TaskDropDeletedContentsFull, s, func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error) {
   453			return dropDeletedContents(ctx, runParams.rep, safeDropTime, safety)

   457	func runTaskRewriteContentsQuick(ctx context.Context, runParams RunParameters, s *Schedule, safety SafetyParameters) error {
   458		return reportRunAndMaybeCheckContentIndex(ctx, runParams.rep, TaskRewriteContentsQuick, s, func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error) {
   459			return RewriteContents(ctx, runParams.rep, &RewriteContentsOptions{
   460				ContentIDRange: index.AllPrefixedIDs,
   461				PackPrefix:     content.PackBlobIDPrefixSpecial,
   462				ShortPacks:     true,
   463			}, safety)
   464		})

   467	func runTaskRewriteContentsFull(ctx context.Context, runParams RunParameters, s *Schedule, safety SafetyParameters) error {
   468		return reportRunAndMaybeCheckContentIndex(ctx, runParams.rep, TaskRewriteContentsFull, s, func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error) {

   470				ContentIDRange: index.AllIDs,
   471				ShortPacks:     true,
   472			}, safety)
   473		})
   474	}

   477		return reportRunAndMaybeCheckContentIndex(ctx, runParams.rep, TaskDeleteOrphanedBlobsFull, s, func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error) {
   478			return DeleteUnreferencedPacks(ctx, runParams.rep, DeleteUnreferencedPacksOptions{

   480				Parallel:     runParams.Params.ListParallelism,

   482		})
   483	}

   489				Prefix:       content.PackBlobIDPrefixSpecial,
   490				Parallel:     runParams.Params.ListParallelism,
   491			}, safety)
   492		})
   493	}

   496		return ReportRun(ctx, runParams.rep, TaskExtendBlobRetentionTimeFull, s, func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error) {
   497			return extendBlobRetentionTime(ctx, runParams.rep, ExtendBlobRetentionTimeOptions{})
   498		})
   499	}
   500	
   501	func runFullMaintenance(ctx context.Context, runParams RunParameters, safety SafetyParameters) error {
   502		log := runParams.rep.LogManager().NewLogger("maintenance-full")
   503	
   504		s, err := GetSchedule(ctx, runParams.rep)
   505		if err != nil {
   506			return errors.Wrap(err, "unable to get schedule")
   507		}
   508	
   509		if shouldFullRewriteContents(s, safety) {
   510			// find packs that are less than 80% full and rewrite contents in them into
   511			// new consolidated packs, orphaning old packs in the process.
   512			if err := runTaskRewriteContentsFull(ctx, runParams, s, safety); err != nil {
   513				return errors.Wrap(err, "error rewriting contents in short packs")
   514			}
   515		} else {
   516			notRewritingContents(ctx, log)
   517		}
   518	
   519		// rewrite indexes by dropping content entries that have been marked
   520		// as deleted for a long time
   521		if err := runTaskDropDeletedContentsFull(ctx, runParams, s, safety); err != nil {
   522			return errors.Wrap(err, "error dropping deleted contents")
   523		}
   524	
   525		if shouldDeleteOrphanedPacks(runParams.rep.Time(), s, safety) {
   526			// delete orphaned packs after some time.
   527			if err := runTaskDeleteOrphanedPacksFull(ctx, runParams, s, safety); err != nil {
   528				return errors.Wrap(err, "error deleting unreferenced blobs")
   529			}
   530		} else {
   531			notDeletingOrphanedPacks(ctx, log, s, safety)
   532		}
   533	
   534		// extend retention-time on supported storage.
   535		if runParams.Params.ExtendObjectLocks {
   536			if err := runTaskExtendBlobRetentionTimeFull(ctx, runParams, s); err != nil {
   537				return errors.Wrap(err, "error extending object lock retention time")
   538			}
   539		} else {
   540			userLog(ctx).Debug("Extending object lock retention-period is disabled.")
   541		}
   542	
   543		if err := runTaskEpochMaintenanceFull(ctx, runParams, s); err != nil {
   544			return errors.Wrap(err, "error cleaning up epoch manager")
   545		}
   546	
   547		// clean up logs last
   548		if err := runTaskCleanupLogs(ctx, runParams, s); err != nil {
   549			return errors.Wrap(err, "error cleaning up logs")
   550		}
   551	
   552		return nil
   553	}
   554	
   555	// shouldQuickRewriteContents returns true if it's currently ok to rewrite contents.
   556	// since each content rewrite will require deleting of orphaned blobs after some time passes,
   557	// we don't want to starve blob deletion by constantly doing rewrites.
   558	func shouldQuickRewriteContents(s *Schedule, safety SafetyParameters) bool {
   559		latestContentRewriteEndTime := maxEndTime(s.Runs[TaskRewriteContentsFull], s.Runs[TaskRewriteContentsQuick])
   560		latestBlobDeleteTime := maxEndTime(s.Runs[TaskDeleteOrphanedBlobsFull], s.Runs[TaskDeleteOrphanedBlobsQuick])
   561	
   562		// never did rewrite - safe to do so.
   563		if latestContentRewriteEndTime.IsZero() || safety.MinRewriteToOrphanDeletionDelay == 0 {
   564			return true
   565		}
   566	
   567		return !latestBlobDeleteTime.Before(latestContentRewriteEndTime)
   568	}
   569	
   570	// shouldFullRewriteContents returns true if it's currently ok to rewrite contents.
   571	// since each content rewrite will require deleting of orphaned blobs after some time passes,
   572	// we don't want to starve blob deletion by constantly doing rewrites.
   573	func shouldFullRewriteContents(s *Schedule, safety SafetyParameters) bool {
   574		// NOTE - we're not looking at TaskRewriteContentsQuick here, this allows full rewrite to sometimes
   575		// follow quick rewrite.
   576		latestContentRewriteEndTime := maxEndTime(s.Runs[TaskRewriteContentsFull])
   577		latestBlobDeleteTime := maxEndTime(s.Runs[TaskDeleteOrphanedBlobsFull], s.Runs[TaskDeleteOrphanedBlobsQuick])
   578	
   579		// never did rewrite - safe to do so.
   580		if latestContentRewriteEndTime.IsZero() || safety.MinRewriteToOrphanDeletionDelay == 0 {
   581			return true
   582		}
   583	
   584		return !latestBlobDeleteTime.Before(latestContentRewriteEndTime)
   585	}
   586	
   587	// shouldDeleteOrphanedPacks returns true if it's ok to delete orphaned packs.
   588	// it is only safe to do so after >1hr since the last content rewrite finished to ensure
   589	// other clients refresh their indexes.
   590	// rewritten packs become orphaned immediately but if we don't wait before their deletion
   591	// clients who have old indexes cached may be trying to read pre-rewrite blobs.
   592	func shouldDeleteOrphanedPacks(now time.Time, s *Schedule, safety SafetyParameters) bool {
   593		return !now.Before(nextPackDeleteTime(s, safety))
   594	}
   595	
   596	func nextPackDeleteTime(s *Schedule, safety SafetyParameters) time.Time {
   597		latestContentRewriteEndTime := maxEndTime(s.Runs[TaskRewriteContentsFull], s.Runs[TaskRewriteContentsQuick])
   598		if latestContentRewriteEndTime.IsZero() {
   599			return time.Time{}
   600		}
   601	
   602		return latestContentRewriteEndTime.Add(safety.MinRewriteToOrphanDeletionDelay)
   603	}
   604	
   605	func hadRecentFullRewrite(s *Schedule) bool {
   606		return !maxEndTime(s.Runs[TaskRewriteContentsFull]).Before(maxEndTime(s.Runs[TaskRewriteContentsQuick]))
   607	}
   608	
   609	func maxEndTime(taskRuns ...[]RunInfo) time.Time {
   610		var result time.Time
   611	
   612		for _, tr := range taskRuns {
   613			for _, r := range tr {
   614				if !r.Success {
   615					continue
   616				}
   617	
   618				if r.End.After(result) {
   619					result = r.End
   620				}
   621			}
   622		}
   623	
   624		return result
   625	}
   626	
   627	// findSafeDropTime returns the latest timestamp for which it is safe to drop content entries
   628	// deleted before that time, because at least two successful GC cycles have completed
   629	// and minimum required time between the GCs has passed.
   630	//
   631	// The worst possible case we need to handle is:
   632	//
   633	// Step #1 - race between GC and snapshot creation:
   634	//
   635	//   - 'snapshot gc' runs and marks unreachable contents as deleted
   636	//   - 'snapshot create' runs at approximately the same time and creates manifest
   637	//     which makes some contents live again.
   638	//
   639	// As a result of this race, GC has marked some entries as incorrectly deleted, but we
   640	// can still return them since they are not dropped from the index.
   641	//
   642	// Step #2 - fix incorrectly deleted contents
   643	//
   644	//   - subsequent 'snapshot gc' runs and undeletes contents incorrectly
   645	//     marked as deleted in Step 1.
   646	//
   647	// After Step 2 completes, we know for sure that all contents deleted before Step #1 has started
   648	// are safe to drop from the index because Step #2 has fixed them, as long as all snapshots that
   649	// were racing with snapshot GC in step #1 have flushed pending writes, hence the
   650	// safety.MarginBetweenSnapshotGC.
   651	func findSafeDropTime(runs []RunInfo, safety SafetyParameters) time.Time {
   652		var successfulRuns []RunInfo
   653	
   654		for _, r := range runs {
   655			if r.Success {
   656				successfulRuns = append(successfulRuns, r)
   657			}
   658		}
   659	
   660		if len(successfulRuns) <= 1 {
   661			return time.Time{}
   662		}
   663	
   664		// sort so that successfulRuns[0] is the latest
   665		sort.Slice(successfulRuns, func(i, j int) bool {
   666			return successfulRuns[i].Start.After(successfulRuns[j].Start)
   667		})
   668	
   669		// Look for previous successful run such that the time between GCs exceeds the safety margin.
   670		for _, r := range successfulRuns[1:] {
   671			diff := -r.End.Sub(successfulRuns[0].Start)
   672			if diff > safety.MarginBetweenSnapshotGC {
   673				return r.Start.Add(-safety.DropContentFromIndexExtraMargin)
   674			}
   675		}
   676	
   677		return time.Time{}
   678	}

## Development

- Primary platform: Linux
- Building requires Go toolchain with the version specified in `go.mod` file
- Do not modify `.gitignore` files

### Code Navigation

ALWAYS use `gopls` LSP tool for Go symbol lookups: definitions, references, implementations, callers. Do NOT use grep for Go symbols; `gopls` is accurate where grep produces false positives and misses generated code.
- `gopls` is a deferred tool: call `ToolSearch` with `query: "select:LSP"` to load its schema before the first use in a session. - Available operations:
   - `goToDefinition`
   - `findReferences`
   - `goToImplementation`
   - `incomingCalls`
   - `outgoingCalls`

### Making Code Changes

1. Set up environment  after cloning the git repository with `make -j4 ci-setup`; this installs `golangci-lint` linter, `gotestsum`, and other required tools

2. Make changes to Go files

3. Build and Lint iteratively
    Duration: ~3-7 minutes
    ```bash
    # Fast build without UI
    make install-noui
    ~/go/bin/kopia --help
    make lint
    ```

4. Unit tests for changes: `make -j4 test`

### Testing

- `make check-locks`
- Race detector test
   ```bash
   make install-race
   make test UNIT_TEST_RACE_FLAGS=-race UNIT_TESTS_TIMEOUT=1200s
   ```
- Integration tests:
    ```bash
    # Build integration test executable
    make build-integration-test-binary
    # Set KOPIA_INTEGRATION_EXE with the path to the kopia executable to use in integration tests
    KOPIA_INTEGRATION_EXE=<path_to_integration_executable> make integration-tests
    ```
- `make endurance-tests` - Long-running endurance tests (1 hour timeout)
- `make stress-test` - Stress tests (1 hour timeout)
- `make compat-tests` - Compatibility tests with older Kopia versions
- `make htmlui-e2e-test` - HTML UI end-to-end tests (10 minutes timeout)

### Dependency Management

- Avoid introducing new dependencies
- Use Go modules, manage dependencies with `go get` and `go mod tidy`

### Formatting

- Indent with tabs
- Keep line length reasonable, consider readability
- Add blank lines to separate logical groups of code, adhering to the linter constraints
- Ensure the file ends with a trailing newline `\n`
- Format with `gofumpt`
- Sort `import` with `goimports`; order: standard, default, localmodule
- Linter: `golangci-lint`,  configuration: `.golangci.yml`, run with: `make lint`
- Auto-fix linting issues: `make lint-fix`

### Git Commits

- Keep commits focused and atomic
- Write meaningful and descriptive commit messages
- Do not commit executables or binary artifacts to git
- Create an initial empty commit with title 'plan(ai): summary' and include the task summary in the commit message

#### Pre-Commit Checks

- Changes are formatted with `gofumpt`
- `make lint vet` passes (3-4 minutes)
- `make test` passes (2-4 minutes)
- License check: `make license-check`
- Review diffs

# Go code in Kopia

## General Instructions

- Write clear, simple, self-documenting code with descriptive names
- Favor clarity and simplicity over cleverness, follow the principle of least surprise
- Follow idiomatic Go practices and standards.
- Reduce nesting and indentation:
  - Prefer early return over if-else chains; use `if condition { return }` pattern to avoid else blocks
  - Keep the non-error path left-aligned
- Avoid introducing new dependencies
- Avoid using emoji in code, comments and documentation
- Close and release resources such as files, network connections and memory buffers

## Naming

- Use allowed ASCII for identifiers, avoid using non-ASCII characters in identifiers

### Package

- Lowercase, single-word package names
- Avoid underscores, hyphens, or mixedCaps
- Choose names that describe what the package provides, not what it contains
- Avoid generic names like `util`, `common`, or `base`

    32	func findInUseContentIDs(ctx context.Context, log *contentlog.Logger, rep repo.Repository, used *bigmap.Set) error {
    33		const loggingPeriod = time.Duration(10) * time.Minute
    34	
    35		ids, err := snapshot.ListSnapshotManifests(ctx, rep, nil, nil)
    36		if err != nil {
    37			return errors.Wrap(err, "unable to list snapshot manifest IDs")
    38		}
    39	
    40		manifests, err := snapshot.LoadSnapshots(ctx, rep, ids)
    41		if err != nil {
    42			return errors.Wrap(err, "unable to load manifest IDs")
    43		}
    44	
    45		w, twerr := snapshotfs.NewTreeWalker(ctx, snapshotfs.TreeWalkerOptions{
    46			EntryCallback: func(ctx context.Context, _ fs.Entry, oid object.ID, _ string) error {
    47				contentIDs, verr := rep.VerifyObject(ctx, oid)
    48				if verr != nil {
    49					return errors.Wrapf(verr, "error verifying %v", oid)
    50				}
    51	
    52				var cidbuf [128]byte
    53	
    54				for _, cid := range contentIDs {
    55					used.Put(ctx, cid.Append(cidbuf[:0]))
    56				}
    57	
    58				return nil
    59			},
    60		})
    61		if twerr != nil {
    62			return errors.Wrap(twerr, "unable to create tree walker")
    63		}
    64	
    65		defer w.Close(ctx)
    66	
    67		contentlog.Log(ctx, log, "Looking for active contents...")
    68	
    69		lastLog := timetrack.StartTimer()
    70	
    71		for i, m := range manifests {
    72			root, err := snapshotfs.SnapshotRoot(rep, m)
    73			if err != nil {
    74				return errors.Wrap(err, "unable to get snapshot root")
    75			}
    76	
    77			if err := w.Process(ctx, root, ""); err != nil {
    78				return errors.Wrap(err, "error processing snapshot root")
    79			}
    80	
    81			if lastLog.Elapsed() >= loggingPeriod {
    82				userLog(ctx).Infow(
    83					"finding contents in live snapshots",
    84					"snapshotsProcessed", i+1,
    85					"totalSnapshots", len(manifests),
    86				)
    87	
    88				lastLog = timetrack.StartTimer()
    89			}
    90		}
    91	
    92		return nil
    93	}

    95	// Run performs garbage collection on all the snapshots in the repository.
    96	func Run(ctx context.Context, rep repo.DirectRepositoryWriter, gcDelete bool, safety maintenance.SafetyParameters, maintenanceStartTime time.Time) error {
    97		err := maintenance.ReportRun(ctx, rep, maintenance.TaskSnapshotGarbageCollection, nil, func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error) {

   104	func runInternal(ctx context.Context, rep repo.DirectRepositoryWriter, gcDelete bool, safety maintenance.SafetyParameters, maintenanceStartTime time.Time) (*maintenancestats.SnapshotGCStats, error) {
   105		ctx = contentlog.WithParams(ctx,
   106			logparam.String("span:snapshot-gc", contentlog.RandomSpanID()))
   107	
   108		log := rep.LogManager().NewLogger("maintenance-snapshot-gc")
   109	
   110		used, serr := bigmap.NewSet(ctx)
   111		if serr != nil {
   112			return nil, errors.Wrap(serr, "unable to create new set")
   113		}
   114		defer used.Close(ctx)
   115	
   116		if err := findInUseContentIDs(ctx, log, rep, used); err != nil {
   117			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "unable to find in-use content ID")
   118		}
   119	
   120		return findUnreferencedAndRepairRereferenced(ctx, log, rep, gcDelete, safety, maintenanceStartTime, used)

   122	
   123	func findUnreferencedAndRepairRereferenced(
   124		ctx context.Context,
   125		log *contentlog.Logger,
   126		rep repo.DirectRepositoryWriter,
   127		gcDelete bool,
   128		safety maintenance.SafetyParameters,
   129		maintenanceStartTime time.Time,
   130		used *bigmap.Set,
   131	) (*maintenancestats.SnapshotGCStats, error) {
   132		var unused, inUse, system, tooRecent, undeleted, deleted stats.CountSum
   133	
   134		contentlog.Log(ctx, log, "Looking for unreferenced contents...")
   135	
   136		// Ensure that the iteration includes deleted contents, so those can be
   137		// undeleted (recovered).
   138		err := rep.ContentReader().IterateContents(ctx, content.IterateOptions{IncludeDeleted: true}, func(ci content.Info) error {
   139			if manifest.ContentPrefix == ci.ContentID.Prefix() {
   140				system.Add(int64(ci.PackedLength))
   141				return nil
   142			}
   143	
   144			var cidbuf [128]byte
   145	
   146			if used.Contains(ci.ContentID.Append(cidbuf[:0])) {
   147				if ci.Deleted {
   148					if err := rep.ContentManager().UndeleteContent(ctx, ci.ContentID); err != nil {
   149						return errors.Wrapf(err, "Could not undelete referenced content: %v", ci)
   150					}
   151	
   152					undeleted.Add(int64(ci.PackedLength))
   153				}
   154	
   155				inUse.Add(int64(ci.PackedLength))
   156	
   157				return nil
   158			}
   159	
   160			if maintenanceStartTime.Sub(ci.Timestamp()) < safety.MinContentAgeSubjectToGC {
   161				contentlog.Log3(ctx, log,
   162					"recent unreferenced content",
   163					contentparam.ContentID("contentID", ci.ContentID),
   164					logparam.Int64("bytes", int64(ci.PackedLength)),
   165					logparam.Time("modified", ci.Timestamp()))
   166				tooRecent.Add(int64(ci.PackedLength))
   167	
   168				return nil
   169			}
   170	
   171			contentlog.Log3(ctx, log,
   172				"unreferenced content",
   173				contentparam.ContentID("contentID", ci.ContentID),
   174				logparam.Int64("bytes", int64(ci.PackedLength)),
   175				logparam.Time("modified", ci.Timestamp()))
   176	
   177			cnt, totalSize := unused.Add(int64(ci.PackedLength))
   178	
   179			if gcDelete {
   180				if err := rep.ContentManager().DeleteContent(ctx, ci.ContentID); err != nil {
   181					return errors.Wrap(err, "error deleting content")
   182				}
   183	
   184				deleted.Add(int64(ci.PackedLength))
   185			}
   186	
   187			if cnt%100000 == 0 {
   188				contentlog.Log2(ctx, log,
   189					"found unused contents so far",
   190					logparam.UInt32("count", cnt),
   191					logparam.Int64("bytes", totalSize))
   192	
   193				if gcDelete {
   194					if err := rep.Flush(ctx); err != nil {
   195						return errors.Wrap(err, "flush error")
   196					}
   197				}
   198			}
   199	
   200			return nil
   201		})
   202	
   203		result := buildGCResult(&unused, &inUse, &system, &tooRecent, &undeleted, &deleted)
   204	
   205		userLog(ctx).Infof("GC found %v unused contents (%v)", result.UnreferencedContentCount, units.BytesString(result.UnreferencedContentSize))
   206		userLog(ctx).Infof("GC found %v unused contents that are too recent to delete (%v)", result.UnreferencedRecentContentCount, units.BytesString(result.UnreferencedRecentContentSize))
   207		userLog(ctx).Infof("GC found %v in-use contents (%v)", result.InUseContentCount, units.BytesString(result.InUseContentSize))
   208		userLog(ctx).Infof("GC found %v in-use system-contents (%v)", result.InUseSystemContentCount, units.BytesString(result.InUseSystemContentSize))
   209		userLog(ctx).Infof("GC undeleted %v contents (%v)", result.RecoveredContentCount, units.BytesString(result.RecoveredContentSize))
   210	
   211		contentlog.Log1(ctx, log, "Snapshot GC", result)
   212	
   213		if err != nil {
   214			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "error iterating contents")
   215		}
   216	
   217		if err := rep.Flush(ctx); err != nil {
   218			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "flush error")
   219		}
   220	
   221		if result.UnreferencedContentCount > 0 && !gcDelete {
   222			return result, errors.New("Not deleting because 'gcDelete' was not set")
   223		}
   224	
   225		return result, nil
   226	}

   228	func buildGCResult(unused, inUse, system, tooRecent, undeleted, deleted *stats.CountSum) *maintenancestats.SnapshotGCStats {
   229		result := &maintenancestats.SnapshotGCStats{}
   230	
   231		cnt, size := unused.Approximate()
   232		result.UnreferencedContentCount = uint64(cnt)
   233		result.UnreferencedContentSize = maintenancestats.ToUint64(size)
   234	
   235		cnt, size = tooRecent.Approximate()
   236		result.UnreferencedRecentContentCount = uint64(cnt)
   237		result.UnreferencedRecentContentSize = maintenancestats.ToUint64(size)
   238	
   239		cnt, size = inUse.Approximate()
   240		result.InUseContentCount = uint64(cnt)
   241		result.InUseContentSize = maintenancestats.ToUint64(size)
   242	
   243		cnt, size = system.Approximate()
   244		result.InUseSystemContentCount = uint64(cnt)
   245		result.InUseSystemContentSize = maintenancestats.ToUint64(size)
   246	
   247		cnt, size = undeleted.Approximate()
   248		result.RecoveredContentCount = uint64(cnt)
   249		result.RecoveredContentSize = maintenancestats.ToUint64(size)
   250	
   251		cnt, size = deleted.Approximate()
   252		result.DeletedContentCount = uint64(cnt)
   253		result.DeletedContentSize = maintenancestats.ToUint64(size)
   254	
   255		return result
   256	}

   299	// SafetyParameters specifies timing parameters that affect safety of maintenance.

   303	
   304		// Snapshot GC: MinContentAgeSubjectToGC is the minimum age of content to be subject to garbage collection.

    60	// shouldRun returns Mode if repository is due for periodic maintenance.

    67		s, err := GetSchedule(ctx, rep)

    70		}
    71	
    72		// check full cycle first, as it does more than the quick cycle

    78	
    79			userLog(ctx).Debugf("not due for full maintenance cycle until %v", s.NextFullMaintenanceTime)

    83	
    84		// no time for full cycle, check quick cycle

   113			userLog(ctx).Debugf("scheduling next full cycle at %v", s.NextFullMaintenanceTime)
   114			userLog(ctx).Debugf("scheduling next quick cycle at %v", s.NextQuickMaintenanceTime)
