   133		rep repo.DirectRepositoryWriter
   134	
   135		Mode Mode
   136	
   137		Params *Params
   138	
   139		// timestamp of the last update of maintenance schedule blob
   140		MaintenanceStartTime time.Time
   141	}
   142	
   143	// NotOwnedError is returned when maintenance cannot run because it is owned by another user.
   144	type NotOwnedError struct {
   145		Owner string
   146	}
   147	
   148	func (e NotOwnedError) Error() string {
   149		return "maintenance must be run by designated user: " + e.Owner
   150	}
   151	
   152	// RunExclusive runs the provided callback if the maintenance is owned by local user and
   153	// lock can be acquired. Lock is passed to the function, which ensures that every call to Run()
   154	// is within the exclusive context.
   155	func RunExclusive(ctx context.Context, rep repo.DirectRepositoryWriter, mode Mode, force bool, cb func(ctx context.Context, runParams RunParameters) error) error {
   156		ctx = contentlog.WithParams(ctx,
   157			logparam.String("span:maintenance", contentlog.RandomSpanID()))
   158	
   159		rep.DisableIndexRefresh()
   160	
   161		p, err := GetParams(ctx, rep)
   162		if err != nil {
   163			return errors.Wrap(err, "unable to get maintenance params")
   164		}
   165	
   166		if !force && !p.isOwnedByByThisUser(rep) {
   167			return NotOwnedError{p.Owner}
   168		}
   169	
   170		if mode == ModeAuto {
   171			mode, err = shouldRun(ctx, rep, p)
   172			if err != nil {
   173				return errors.Wrap(err, "unable to determine if maintenance is required")
   174			}
   175		}
   176	
   177		if mode == ModeNone {
   178			userLog(ctx).Debug("not due for maintenance")
   179			return nil
   180		}
   181	
   182		lockFile := rep.ConfigFilename() + ".mlock"
   183		userLog(ctx).Debugf("Acquiring maintenance lock in file %v", lockFile)
   184	
   185		// acquire local lock on a config file
   186		l := flock.New(lockFile)
   187	
   188		ok, err := l.TryLock()
   189		if err != nil {
   190			return errors.Wrap(err, "error acquiring maintenance lock")
   191		}
   192	
   193		if !ok {
   194			userLog(ctx).Debug("maintenance is already in progress locally")
   195			return nil
   196		}
   197	
   198		defer l.Unlock() //nolint:errcheck
   199	
   200		runParams := RunParameters{rep, mode, p, time.Time{}}
   201	
   202		// update schedule so that we don't run the maintenance again immediately if
   203		// this process crashes.
   204		if err = updateSchedule(ctx, runParams); err != nil {
   205			return errors.Wrap(err, "error updating maintenance schedule")
   206		}
   207	
   208		bm, err := runParams.rep.BlobReader().GetMetadata(ctx, maintenanceScheduleBlobID)
   209		if err != nil {
   210			return errors.Wrap(err, "error getting maintenance blob time")
   211		}
   212	
   213		runParams.MaintenanceStartTime = bm.Timestamp
   214	
   215		if err = checkClockSkewBounds(runParams); err != nil {
   216			return errors.Wrap(err, "error checking for clock skew")
   217		}
   218	
   219		userLog(ctx).Infof("Running %v maintenance...", runParams.Mode)
   220		defer userLog(ctx).Infof("Finished %v maintenance.", runParams.Mode)
   221	
   222		if err := runParams.rep.Refresh(ctx); err != nil {
   223			return errors.Wrap(err, "error refreshing indexes before maintenance")
   224		}
   225	
   226		return cb(ctx, runParams)
   227	}
   228	
   229	func checkClockSkewBounds(rp RunParameters) error {
   230		localTime := rp.rep.Time()
   231		repoTime := rp.MaintenanceStartTime
   232	
   233		clockSkew := repoTime.Sub(localTime)
   234		if clockSkew < 0 {
   235			clockSkew = -clockSkew
   236		}
   237	
   238		if clockSkew > maxClockSkew {
   239			return errors.Errorf("clock skew detected: local clock is out of sync with repository timestamp by more than allowed %v (local: %v repository: %v skew: %s). Refusing to run maintenance.", maxClockSkew, localTime, repoTime, clockSkew) //nolint:revive
   240		}
   241	
   242		return nil
   243	}
   244	
   245	// Run performs maintenance activities for a repository.
   246	func Run(ctx context.Context, runParams RunParameters, safety SafetyParameters) error {
   247		switch runParams.Mode {
   248		case ModeQuick:
   249			return runQuickMaintenance(ctx, runParams, safety)
   250	
   251		case ModeFull:
   252			return runFullMaintenance(ctx, runParams, safety)
   253	
   254		default:
   255			return errors.Errorf("unknown mode %q", runParams.Mode)
   256		}
   257	}
   258	
   259	func runQuickMaintenance(ctx context.Context, runParams RunParameters, safety SafetyParameters) error {
   260		log := runParams.rep.LogManager().NewLogger("maintenance-quick")
   261	
   262		s, err := GetSchedule(ctx, runParams.rep)
   263		if err != nil {
   264			return errors.Wrap(err, "unable to get schedule")
   265		}
   266	
   267		em, ok, emerr := runParams.rep.ContentManager().EpochManager(ctx)
   268		if ok {
   269			userLog(ctx).Debug("running quick epoch maintenance only")
   270	
   271			return runTaskEpochMaintenanceQuick(ctx, em, runParams, s)
   272		}
   273	
   274		if emerr != nil {
   275			return errors.Wrap(emerr, "epoch manager")
   276		}
   277	
   278		if shouldQuickRewriteContents(s, safety) {
   279			// find 'q' packs that are less than 80% full and rewrite contents in them into
   280			// new consolidated packs, orphaning old packs in the process.
   281			if err := runTaskRewriteContentsQuick(ctx, runParams, s, safety); err != nil {
   282				return errors.Wrap(err, "error rewriting metadata contents")
   283			}
   284		} else {
   285			notRewritingContents(ctx, log)
   286		}
   287	
   288		if shouldDeleteOrphanedPacks(runParams.rep.Time(), s, safety) {
   289			var err error
   290	
   291			// time to delete orphaned blobs after last rewrite,
   292			// if the last rewrite was full (started as part of full maintenance) we must complete it by
   293			// running full orphaned blob deletion, otherwise next quick maintenance will start a quick rewrite
   294			// and we'd never delete blobs orphaned by full rewrite.
   295			if hadRecentFullRewrite(s) {
   296				userLog(ctx).Debug("Had recent full rewrite - performing full pack deletion.")
   297				err = runTaskDeleteOrphanedPacksFull(ctx, runParams, s, safety)
   298			} else {
   299				userLog(ctx).Debug("Performing quick pack deletion.")
   300				err = runTaskDeleteOrphanedPacksQuick(ctx, runParams, s, safety)
   301			}
   302	
   303			if err != nil {
   304				return errors.Wrap(err, "error deleting unreferenced metadata packs")
   305			}
   306		} else {
   307			notDeletingOrphanedPacks(ctx, log, s, safety)
   308		}
   309	
   310		// consolidate many smaller indexes into fewer larger ones.
   311		if err := runTaskIndexCompactionQuick(contentlog.WithParams(ctx, logparam.String("span:index-compaction", contentlog.RandomSpanID())), runParams, s, safety); err != nil {
   312			return errors.Wrap(err, "error performing index compaction")
   313		}
   314	
   315		// clean up logs last
   316		if err := runTaskCleanupLogs(contentlog.WithParams(ctx, logparam.String("span:cleanup-logs", contentlog.RandomSpanID())), runParams, s); err != nil {
   317			return errors.Wrap(err, "error cleaning up logs")
   318		}
   319	
   320		return nil
   321	}
   322	
   323	func notRewritingContents(ctx context.Context, log *contentlog.Logger) {
   324		contentlog.Log(ctx, log, "Previous content rewrite has not been finalized yet, waiting until the next blob deletion.")
   325	}
   326	
   327	func notDeletingOrphanedPacks(ctx context.Context, log *contentlog.Logger, s *Schedule, safety SafetyParameters) {
   328		left := nextPackDeleteTime(s, safety).Sub(clock.Now()).Truncate(time.Second)
   329	
   330		contentlog.Log1(ctx, log, "Skipping pack deletion because not enough time has passed yet", logparam.Duration("left", left))
   331	}
   332	
   333	func runTaskCleanupLogs(ctx context.Context, runParams RunParameters, s *Schedule) error {
   334		return ReportRun(ctx, runParams.rep, TaskCleanupLogs, s, func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error) {
   335			stats, err := CleanupLogs(ctx, runParams.rep, runParams.Params.LogRetention.OrDefault())
   336	
   337			var deletedLogCount uint64
   338			if stats != nil {
   339				deletedLogCount = stats.DeletedBlobCount
   340			}
   341	
   342			userLog(ctx).Infof("Cleaned up %v logs.", deletedLogCount)
   343	
   344			return stats, err
   345		})
   346	}
   347	
   348	func runTaskEpochAdvance(ctx context.Context, em *epoch.Manager, runParams RunParameters, s *Schedule) error {
   349		return reportRunAndMaybeCheckContentIndex(ctx, runParams.rep, TaskEpochAdvance, s, func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error) {
   350			userLog(ctx).Info("Advancing epoch markers...")
   351	
   352			stats, err := em.MaybeAdvanceWriteEpoch(ctx)
   353	
   354			return stats, errors.Wrap(err, "error advancing epoch marker")
   355		})
   356	}
   357	
   358	func runTaskEpochMaintenanceQuick(ctx context.Context, em *epoch.Manager, runParams RunParameters, s *Schedule) error {
   359		err := reportRunAndMaybeCheckContentIndex(ctx, runParams.rep, TaskEpochCompactSingle, s, func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error) {
   360			userLog(ctx).Info("Compacting an eligible uncompacted epoch...")
   361	
   362			stats, err := em.MaybeCompactSingleEpoch(ctx)
   363	
   364			return stats, errors.Wrap(err, "error compacting single epoch")
   365		})
   366		if err != nil {
   367			return err
   368		}
   369	
   370		err = runTaskEpochAdvance(ctx, em, runParams, s)
   371	
   372		return errors.Wrap(err, "error to advance epoch in quick epoch maintenance task")
   373	}
   374	
   375	func runTaskEpochMaintenanceFull(ctx context.Context, runParams RunParameters, s *Schedule) error {
   376		em, hasEpochManager, emerr := runParams.rep.ContentManager().EpochManager(ctx)
   377		if emerr != nil {
   378			return errors.Wrap(emerr, "epoch manager")
   379		}
   380	
   381		if !hasEpochManager {
   382			return nil
   383		}
   384	
   385		// compact a single epoch
   386		if err := reportRunAndMaybeCheckContentIndex(ctx, runParams.rep, TaskEpochCompactSingle, s, func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error) {
   387			userLog(ctx).Info("Compacting an eligible uncompacted epoch...")
   388	
   389			stats, err := em.MaybeCompactSingleEpoch(ctx)
   390	
   391			return stats, errors.Wrap(err, "error compacting single epoch")
   392		}); err != nil {
   393			return err
   394		}
   395	
   396		if err := runTaskEpochAdvance(ctx, em, runParams, s); err != nil {
   397			return err
   398		}
   399	
   400		// compact range
   401		if err := reportRunAndMaybeCheckContentIndex(ctx, runParams.rep, TaskEpochGenerateRange, s, func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error) {
   402			userLog(ctx).Info("Attempting to compact a range of epoch indexes ...")
   403	
   404			stats, err := em.MaybeGenerateRangeCheckpoint(ctx)
   405	
   406			return stats, errors.Wrap(err, "error creating epoch range indexes")
   407		}); err != nil {
   408			return err
   409		}
   410	
   411		// clean up epoch markers
   412		err := ReportRun(ctx, runParams.rep, TaskEpochCleanupMarkers, s, func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error) {
   413			userLog(ctx).Info("Cleaning up unneeded epoch markers...")
   414	
   415			stats, err := em.CleanupMarkers(ctx)
   416	
   417			return stats, errors.Wrap(err, "error removing epoch markers")
   418		})
   419		if err != nil {
   420			return err
   421		}
   422	
   423		return reportRunAndMaybeCheckContentIndex(ctx, runParams.rep, TaskEpochDeleteSupersededIndexes, s, func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error) {
   424			userLog(ctx).Info("Cleaning up old index blobs which have already been compacted...")
   425	
   426			stats, err := em.CleanupSupersededIndexes(ctx)
   427	
   428			return stats, errors.Wrap(err, "error removing superseded epoch index blobs")
   429		})
   430	}
   431	
   432	func runTaskDropDeletedContentsFull(ctx context.Context, runParams RunParameters, s *Schedule, safety SafetyParameters) error {
   433		var safeDropTime time.Time
   434	
   435		log := runParams.rep.LogManager().NewLogger("maintenance-drop-deleted-contents")
   436	
   437		if safety.RequireTwoGCCycles {
   438			safeDropTime = findSafeDropTime(s.Runs[TaskSnapshotGarbageCollection], safety)
   439		} else {
   440			safeDropTime = runParams.rep.Time()
   441		}
   442	
   443		if safeDropTime.IsZero() {
   444			contentlog.Log(ctx, log,
   445				"Not forgetting deleted contents yet since not enough time has passed since previous successful Snapshot GC. Will try again next time.")
   446	
   447			return nil
   448		}
   449	
   450		contentlog.Log1(ctx, log, "Found safe time to drop indexes", logparam.Time("safeDropTime", safeDropTime))
   451	
   452		return reportRunAndMaybeCheckContentIndex(ctx, runParams.rep, TaskDropDeletedContentsFull, s, func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error) {
   453			return dropDeletedContents(ctx, runParams.rep, safeDropTime, safety)
   454		})
   455	}
   456	
   457	func runTaskRewriteContentsQuick(ctx context.Context, runParams RunParameters, s *Schedule, safety SafetyParameters) error {
   458		return reportRunAndMaybeCheckContentIndex(ctx, runParams.rep, TaskRewriteContentsQuick, s, func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error) {
   459			return RewriteContents(ctx, runParams.rep, &RewriteContentsOptions{
   460				ContentIDRange: index.AllPrefixedIDs,
   461				PackPrefix:     content.PackBlobIDPrefixSpecial,
   462				ShortPacks:     true,
   463			}, safety)
   464		})
   465	}
   466	
   467	func runTaskRewriteContentsFull(ctx context.Context, runParams RunParameters, s *Schedule, safety SafetyParameters) error {
   468		return reportRunAndMaybeCheckContentIndex(ctx, runParams.rep, TaskRewriteContentsFull, s, func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error) {
   469			return RewriteContents(ctx, runParams.rep, &RewriteContentsOptions{
   470				ContentIDRange: index.AllIDs,
   471				ShortPacks:     true,
   472			}, safety)
   473		})
   474	}
   475	
   476	func runTaskDeleteOrphanedPacksFull(ctx context.Context, runParams RunParameters, s *Schedule, safety SafetyParameters) error {
   477		return reportRunAndMaybeCheckContentIndex(ctx, runParams.rep, TaskDeleteOrphanedBlobsFull, s, func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error) {
   478			return DeleteUnreferencedPacks(ctx, runParams.rep, DeleteUnreferencedPacksOptions{
   479				NotAfterTime: runParams.MaintenanceStartTime,
   480				Parallel:     runParams.Params.ListParallelism,
   481			}, safety)
   482		})
   483	}
   484	
   485	func runTaskDeleteOrphanedPacksQuick(ctx context.Context, runParams RunParameters, s *Schedule, safety SafetyParameters) error {
   486		return reportRunAndMaybeCheckContentIndex(ctx, runParams.rep, TaskDeleteOrphanedBlobsQuick, s, func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error) {
   487			return DeleteUnreferencedPacks(ctx, runParams.rep, DeleteUnreferencedPacksOptions{
   488				NotAfterTime: runParams.MaintenanceStartTime,
   489				Prefix:       content.PackBlobIDPrefixSpecial,
   490				Parallel:     runParams.Params.ListParallelism,
   491			}, safety)
   492		})
   493	}
   494	
   495	func runTaskExtendBlobRetentionTimeFull(ctx context.Context, runParams RunParameters, s *Schedule) error {
   496		return ReportRun(ctx, runParams.rep, TaskExtendBlobRetentionTimeFull, s, func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error) {
   497			return extendBlobRetentionTime(ctx, runParams.rep, ExtendBlobRetentionTimeOptions{})
   498		})
   499	}
   500	
   501	func runFullMaintenance(ctx context.Context, runParams RunParameters, safety SafetyParameters) error {
   502		log := runParams.rep.LogManager().NewLogger("maintenance-full")
   503	
   504		s, err := GetSchedule(ctx, runParams.rep)
   505		if err != nil {
   506			return errors.Wrap(err, "unable to get schedule")
   507		}
   508	
   509		if shouldFullRewriteContents(s, safety) {
   510			// find packs that are less than 80% full and rewrite contents in them into
   511			// new consolidated packs, orphaning old packs in the process.
   512			if err := runTaskRewriteContentsFull(ctx, runParams, s, safety); err != nil {
   513				return errors.Wrap(err, "error rewriting contents in short packs")
   514			}
   515		} else {
   516			notRewritingContents(ctx, log)
   517		}
   518	
   519		// rewrite indexes by dropping content entries that have been marked
   520		// as deleted for a long time
   521		if err := runTaskDropDeletedContentsFull(ctx, runParams, s, safety); err != nil {
   522			return errors.Wrap(err, "error dropping deleted contents")
   523		}
   524	
   525		if shouldDeleteOrphanedPacks(runParams.rep.Time(), s, safety) {
   526			// delete orphaned packs after some time.
   527			if err := runTaskDeleteOrphanedPacksFull(ctx, runParams, s, safety); err != nil {
   528				return errors.Wrap(err, "error deleting unreferenced blobs")
   529			}
   530		} else {
   531			notDeletingOrphanedPacks(ctx, log, s, safety)
   532		}
   533	
   534		// extend retention-time on supported storage.
   535		if runParams.Params.ExtendObjectLocks {
   536			if err := runTaskExtendBlobRetentionTimeFull(ctx, runParams, s); err != nil {
   537				return errors.Wrap(err, "error extending object lock retention time")
   538			}
   539		} else {
   540			userLog(ctx).Debug("Extending object lock retention-period is disabled.")
   541		}
   542	
   543		if err := runTaskEpochMaintenanceFull(ctx, runParams, s); err != nil {
   544			return errors.Wrap(err, "error cleaning up epoch manager")
   545		}
   546	
   547		// clean up logs last
   548		if err := runTaskCleanupLogs(ctx, runParams, s); err != nil {
   549			return errors.Wrap(err, "error cleaning up logs")
   550		}
   551	
   552		return nil
   553	}
   554	
   555	// shouldQuickRewriteContents returns true if it's currently ok to rewrite contents.
   556	// since each content rewrite will require deleting of orphaned blobs after some time passes,
   557	// we don't want to starve blob deletion by constantly doing rewrites.
   558	func shouldQuickRewriteContents(s *Schedule, safety SafetyParameters) bool {
   559		latestContentRewriteEndTime := maxEndTime(s.Runs[TaskRewriteContentsFull], s.Runs[TaskRewriteContentsQuick])
   560		latestBlobDeleteTime := maxEndTime(s.Runs[TaskDeleteOrphanedBlobsFull], s.Runs[TaskDeleteOrphanedBlobsQuick])
   561	
   562		// never did rewrite - safe to do so.
   563		if latestContentRewriteEndTime.IsZero() || safety.MinRewriteToOrphanDeletionDelay == 0 {
   564			return true
   565		}
   566	
   567		return !latestBlobDeleteTime.Before(latestContentRewriteEndTime)
   568	}
   569	
   570	// shouldFullRewriteContents returns true if it's currently ok to rewrite contents.
   571	// since each content rewrite will require deleting of orphaned blobs after some time passes,
   572	// we don't want to starve blob deletion by constantly doing rewrites.
   573	func shouldFullRewriteContents(s *Schedule, safety SafetyParameters) bool {
   574		// NOTE - we're not looking at TaskRewriteContentsQuick here, this allows full rewrite to sometimes
   575		// follow quick rewrite.
   576		latestContentRewriteEndTime := maxEndTime(s.Runs[TaskRewriteContentsFull])
   577		latestBlobDeleteTime := maxEndTime(s.Runs[TaskDeleteOrphanedBlobsFull], s.Runs[TaskDeleteOrphanedBlobsQuick])
   578	
   579		// never did rewrite - safe to do so.
   580		if latestContentRewriteEndTime.IsZero() || safety.MinRewriteToOrphanDeletionDelay == 0 {
   581			return true
   582		}
   583	
   584		return !latestBlobDeleteTime.Before(latestContentRewriteEndTime)
   585	}
   586	
   587	// shouldDeleteOrphanedPacks returns true if it's ok to delete orphaned packs.
   588	// it is only safe to do so after >1hr since the last content rewrite finished to ensure
   589	// other clients refresh their indexes.
   590	// rewritten packs become orphaned immediately but if we don't wait before their deletion
   591	// clients who have old indexes cached may be trying to read pre-rewrite blobs.
   592	func shouldDeleteOrphanedPacks(now time.Time, s *Schedule, safety SafetyParameters) bool {
   593		return !now.Before(nextPackDeleteTime(s, safety))
   594	}
   595	
   596	func nextPackDeleteTime(s *Schedule, safety SafetyParameters) time.Time {
   597		latestContentRewriteEndTime := maxEndTime(s.Runs[TaskRewriteContentsFull], s.Runs[TaskRewriteContentsQuick])
   598		if latestContentRewriteEndTime.IsZero() {
   599			return time.Time{}
   600		}
   601	
   602		return latestContentRewriteEndTime.Add(safety.MinRewriteToOrphanDeletionDelay)
   603	}
   604	
   605	func hadRecentFullRewrite(s *Schedule) bool {
   606		return !maxEndTime(s.Runs[TaskRewriteContentsFull]).Before(maxEndTime(s.Runs[TaskRewriteContentsQuick]))
   607	}
   608	
   609	func maxEndTime(taskRuns ...[]RunInfo) time.Time {
   610		var result time.Time
   611	
   612		for _, tr := range taskRuns {
   613			for _, r := range tr {
   614				if !r.Success {
   615					continue
   616				}
   617	
   618				if r.End.After(result) {
   619					result = r.End
   620				}
   621			}
   622		}
   623	
   624		return result
   625	}
   626	
   627	// findSafeDropTime returns the latest timestamp for which it is safe to drop content entries
   628	// deleted before that time, because at least two successful GC cycles have completed
   629	// and minimum required time between the GCs has passed.
   630	//
   631	// The worst possible case we need to handle is:
   632	//
   633	// Step #1 - race between GC and snapshot creation:
   634	//
   635	//   - 'snapshot gc' runs and marks unreachable contents as deleted
   636	//   - 'snapshot create' runs at approximately the same time and creates manifest
   637	//     which makes some contents live again.
   638	//
   639	// As a result of this race, GC has marked some entries as incorrectly deleted, but we
   640	// can still return them since they are not dropped from the index.
   641	//
   642	// Step #2 - fix incorrectly deleted contents
   643	//
   644	//   - subsequent 'snapshot gc' runs and undeletes contents incorrectly
   645	//     marked as deleted in Step 1.
   646	//
   647	// After Step 2 completes, we know for sure that all contents deleted before Step #1 has started
   648	// are safe to drop from the index because Step #2 has fixed them, as long as all snapshots that
   649	// were racing with snapshot GC in step #1 have flushed pending writes, hence the
   650	// safety.MarginBetweenSnapshotGC.
   651	func findSafeDropTime(runs []RunInfo, safety SafetyParameters) time.Time {
   652		var successfulRuns []RunInfo
   653	
   654		for _, r := range runs {
   655			if r.Success {
   656				successfulRuns = append(successfulRuns, r)
   657			}
   658		}
   659	
   660		if len(successfulRuns) <= 1 {
   661			return time.Time{}
   662		}
   663	
   664		// sort so that successfulRuns[0] is the latest
   665		sort.Slice(successfulRuns, func(i, j int) bool {
   666			return successfulRuns[i].Start.After(successfulRuns[j].Start)
   667		})
   668	
   669		// Look for previous successful run such that the time between GCs exceeds the safety margin.
   670		for _, r := range successfulRuns[1:] {
   671			diff := -r.End.Sub(successfulRuns[0].Start)
   672			if diff > safety.MarginBetweenSnapshotGC {
   673				return r.Start.Add(-safety.DropContentFromIndexExtraMargin)
   674			}
   675		}
   676	
   677		return time.Time{}
   678	}

# Go code in Kopia

## General Instructions

- Write clear, simple, self-documenting code with descriptive names
- Favor clarity and simplicity over cleverness, follow the principle of least surprise
- Follow idiomatic Go practices and standards.
- Reduce nesting and indentation:
  - Prefer early return over if-else chains; use `if condition { return }` pattern to avoid else blocks
  - Keep the non-error path left-aligned
- Avoid introducing new dependencies
- Avoid using emoji in code, comments and documentation
- Close and release resources such as files, network connections and memory buffers

## Naming

- Use allowed ASCII for identifiers, avoid using non-ASCII characters in identifiers

### Package

- Lowercase, single-word package names
- Avoid underscores, hyphens, or mixedCaps
- Choose names that describe what the package provides, not what it contains
- Avoid generic names like `util`, `common`, or `base`
- Each `.go` file must have exactly one `package` line, never have multiple `package` declarations in a file

### Variables and Functions

- Use mixedCaps or MixedCaps (camelCase) rather than underscores
- Keep names short but descriptive
- Use single-letter variables only for short scopes (like loop indices)
- Exported names start with a capital letter
- Unexported names start with a lowercase letter
- Avoid using the same name for the package and a type, (e.g., avoid `http.HTTPServer`, prefer `http.Server`)

### Interfaces

- Name interfaces with -er suffix when possible (e.g., `Reader`, `Writer`, `Formatter`)
- Name single-method interfaces after method name (e.g., method `Read`, interface `Reader`)
- Keep interfaces small

### Constants

- Exported constants: MixedCaps starting with a capital letter
- Unexported constants mixedCaps starting with a lowercase letter
- Group related constants with `const` blocks
- Use typed constants for type safety

## Code Comments and Documentation

### Comments

- Write self-documenting code; prefer clear variable names, function names, and code structure over comments and write no comments by default
- Comments explain rationale, not how it is done unless the implementation is complex
- Write comments only when necessary to explain constraints, subtlety, complex implementation, non-obvious behavior, workarounds for specific bugs
- Write comments and documentation in English, avoid emoji
- Use line comments (`//`) for most comments
- Keep comments close to implementation

### Documentation

- Document meaning and usage of structs, interfaces and fields
- Document exported symbols with clear, concise explanations
- Document the invariants expected when calling a function, the change of state
  if any, and the expected state invariant when a function returns.
- Start documentation with symbol name
- Package comments start with "Package [name]"
- Document configuration options
- Examples when helpful
- Update documentation when code changes

## Type Safety and Language Features

- Prefer specific types or generic type parameters with constraints. If an unconstrained type is required, use `any` rather than `interface{}`
- Leverage and prefer the Go standard library when functionality exists instead of writing custom implementations (e.g., use `strings.Builder` for string concatenation, `filepath.Join` for path construction)
- Use `defer` for cleanup

### Type Definitions

- Define types to add meaning and type safety
- Prefer explicit type conversions
- Use type assertions carefully and check whether the assertion succeeds using the second return value
- Prefer generics over unconstrained types; when an unconstrained type is truly needed, use the predeclared alias `any` instead of `interface{}`
- Make the zero value useful

### Interfaces and Composition

- Accept interfaces, return concrete types
- Keep interfaces small (1-3 methods is ideal)
- Define interfaces close to where they're used, not where they're implemented
- Don't export interfaces unless necessary
- Use embedding for composition

### Package Organization

- Group related functionality into packages
- Put reusable packages in `internal/` if possible
- Avoid circular dependencies

### Pointers vs Values Parameters and Receivers

- Consistent receiver type, either pointer receivers or value receivers for all receiver functions of given type
- Pointer receivers for large structs or when modifying receiver, value receivers for small immutable structs
- Prefer value parameters over pointer parameters
- Pointer parameters when parameter large or need to modify argument
- Consider zero value when choosing pointer vs value arguments

### JSON APIs

- Use struct tags to specify lower `camelCase` field names in JSON marshaling
- Validate input data
- Use pointers for optional fields
- Consider using `json.RawMessage` for delayed parsing
- Handle JSON marshaling errors

## Error Handling Patterns

### Error Handling and Propagation

- Name error variables `err`
- Check errors immediately after function call
- Don't ignore errors using `_` unless valid reason (explain why)
- Don't log and return errors (choose one)
- Place error returns as the last return value
- Preserve error chains, wrap errors with context message using `errors.Wrap()`
- Error checking with `errors.Is` and `errors.As`

### Creating Errors

- Create and export sentinel error variables with `errors.New` when checking for specific errors is needed
- Error messages: lowercase, descriptive, don't end with punctuation
- Use structured errors with fields

### Error Lists and Multiple Errors

- Use `errors.Join()` for collecting multiple errors (nil-safe)
- Handle validation scenarios with error accumulation

## Concurrency

### Goroutines

- Use `sync.WaitGroup` or channels to wait for goroutines
- Avoid creating goroutines in libraries; prefer letting the caller control concurrency
- If you must create goroutines in libraries, provide clear documentation and cleanup mechanisms
- Avoid goroutine leaks by ensuring cleanup, determine how a goroutine will exit

### Channels

- Use channels to communicate between goroutines
- Use `select` for non-blocking operations
- Close channels from the sender side, not the receiver
- Don't communicate by sharing memory; share memory by communicating
- Use buffered channels when capacity is known upfront

### Synchronization

- Keep critical sections small
- Choose between channels and mutexes based on the use case: use channels for communication, mutexes for protecting state
- Use `sync.Mutex` for protecting shared state
- Use `sync.RWMutex` when there are many readers
- Use `sync.Once` for one-time initialization

## Memory Management

- Minimize allocations in hot paths
- Reuse objects when a large number of those are allocated (consider `sync.Pool`)
- Use value receivers for small structs
- Preallocate slices when size is known
- Avoid unnecessary string-byte conversions


## I/O: Readers and Buffers

- Most `io.Reader` streams are consumable once; reading advances state. Do not assume a reader can be re-read without special handling
- If you must read data multiple times, buffer it once and recreate readers on demand:
	- Use `io.ReadAll` (or a limited read) to obtain `[]byte`, then create fresh readers via `bytes.NewReader(buf)` or `bytes.NewBuffer(buf)` for each reuse
	- For strings, use `strings.NewReader(s)`;
	- `Seek(0, io.SeekStart)` rewinds `*bytes.Reader`
- For HTTP requests, do not reuse a consumed `req.Body`. Instead:
	- Keep the original payload as `[]byte` and set `req.Body = io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader(buf))` before each send
	- Prefer configuring `req.GetBody` so the transport can recreate the body for redirects/retries: `req.GetBody = func() (io.ReadCloser, error) { return io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader(buf)), nil }`
- To duplicate a stream while reading, use `io.TeeReader` (copy to a buffer while passing through) or write to multiple sinks with `io.MultiWriter`
- Reusing buffered readers: call `(*bufio.Reader).Reset(r)` to attach to a new underlying reader; do not expect it to "rewind" unless the source supports seeking
- For large payloads, avoid unbounded buffering; consider streaming, `io.LimitReader`, or on-disk temporary storage to control memory

- Use `io.Pipe` to stream without buffering the whole payload:
	- Write to `*io.PipeWriter` in a separate goroutine while the reader consumes
	- Always close the writer; use `CloseWithError(err)` on failures
	- `io.Pipe` is for streaming, not rewinding or making readers reusable

- Warning: When using `io.Pipe` (especially with multipart writers), all writes must be performed in strict, sequential order. Do not write concurrently or out of order—multipart boundaries and chunk order must be preserved. Out-of-order or parallel writes can corrupt the stream and result in errors.

- Streaming multipart/form-data with `io.Pipe`:
	- `pr, pw := io.Pipe()`; `mw := multipart.NewWriter(pw)`; use `pr` as the HTTP request body
	- Set `Content-Type` to `mw.FormDataContentType()`
	- In a goroutine: write all parts to `mw` in the correct order; on error `pw.CloseWithError(err)`; on success `mw.Close()` then `pw.Close()`
	- Do not store request/in-flight form state on a long-lived client; build per call
	- Streamed bodies are not rewindable; for retries/redirects, buffer small payloads or provide `GetBody`

## Security Best Practices

### Input Validation

- Use strong typing to prevent invalid states
- Validate all external input
- Validate and escape data for different contexts (HTML, SQL, shell)
- Sanitize file paths from user input
- Sanitize input before SQL queries

### Cryptography

- Use standard library crypto packages
- Use crypto/rand for random number generation
- Use TLS for network communication
- Never store plain-text passwords
- Store password hashes using functions designed for password hashing, such as PBKDF2 and scrypt

## Constraints

- Use `clock.Now()` instead of `time.Now()`
- Use `timetrack.Timer.Elapsed()` instead of `time.Since()`
- No `filepath.IsAbs()` - use `ospath.IsAbs()` for Windows UNC support

## Pitfalls to Avoid

- Ignoring race conditions
- Creating goroutine leaks
- Modifying maps concurrently
- Using global variables unnecessarily
- Not considering the zero value of types
- Creating duplicate `package` declarations, this is a compile error; always check existing files before adding package declarations

## References

- Linter configuration: `.golangci.yml`
- https://go.dev/doc/effective_go
- https://go.dev/wiki/CodeReviewComments
- https://google.github.io/styleguide/go/guide

- Mark helper functions with `t.Helper()`
- Create test fixtures for complex setup
- Use `testing.TB` interface for functions used in tests and benchmarks
- Clean up resources using `t.Cleanup()`

   287				for c := range cnt {
   288					if c.err != nil {
   289						failedCount.Add(1)
   290	
   291						return
   292					}
   293	
   294					age := rep.Time().Sub(c.Timestamp())
   295					if age < safety.RewriteMinAge {
   296						contentlog.Log5(ctx, log,
   297							"Not rewriting content",
   298							contentparam.ContentID("contentID", c.ContentID),
   299							logparam.UInt32("bytes", c.PackedLength),
   300							blobparam.BlobID("packBlobID", c.PackBlobID),
   301							logparam.Bool("deleted", c.Deleted),
   302							logparam.Duration("age", age))
   303	
   304						retained.Add(int64(c.PackedLength))
   305	
   306						continue
   307					}
   308	
   309					contentlog.Log5(ctx, log,
   310						"Rewriting content",
   311						contentparam.ContentID("contentID", c.ContentID),
   312						logparam.UInt32("bytes", c.PackedLength),
   313						blobparam.BlobID("packBlobID", c.PackBlobID),
   314						logparam.Bool("deleted", c.Deleted),
   315						logparam.Duration("age", age))
   316	
   317					toRewrite.Add(int64(c.PackedLength))
   318	
   319					if opt.DryRun {
   320						continue
   321					}
   322	
   323					if err := rep.ContentManager().RewriteContent(ctx, c.ContentID); err != nil {
   324						// provide option to ignore failures when rewriting deleted contents during maintenance
   325						// this is for advanced use only
   326						if envflag.Bool("KOPIA_IGNORE_MAINTENANCE_REWRITE_ERROR") && c.Deleted {
   327							contentlog.Log2(ctx, log,
   328								"IGNORED: unable to rewrite deleted content",
   329								contentparam.ContentID("contentID", c.ContentID),
   330								logparam.Error("error", err))
   331						} else {
   332							contentlog.Log2(ctx, log,
   333								"unable to rewrite content",
   334								contentparam.ContentID("contentID", c.ContentID),
   335								logparam.Error("error", err))
   336	
   337							failedCount.Add(1)
   338						}
   339					} else {
   340						rewritten.Add(int64(c.PackedLength))
   341					}
   342				}
   343			})
   344		}
   345	
   346		wg.Wait()
   347	
   348		toRewriteCount, toRewriteBytes := toRewrite.Approximate()
   349		retainedCount, retainedBytes := retained.Approximate()
   350		rewrittenCount, rewrittenBytes := rewritten.Approximate()
   351	
   352		result := &maintenancestats.RewriteContentsStats{
   353			ToRewriteContentCount: uint64(toRewriteCount),
   354			ToRewriteContentSize:  maintenancestats.ToUint64(toRewriteBytes),
   355			RewrittenContentCount: uint64(rewrittenCount),
   356			RewrittenContentSize:  maintenancestats.ToUint64(rewrittenBytes),
   357			RetainedContentCount:  uint64(retainedCount),
   358			RetainedContentSize:   maintenancestats.ToUint64(retainedBytes),
   359		}
   360	
   361		contentlog.Log1(ctx, log, "Rewritten contents", result)
   362	
   363		if failedCount.Load() == 0 {
   364			if err := rep.ContentManager().Flush(ctx); err != nil {
   365				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "error flushing repo")
   366			}
   367	
   368			return result, nil
   369		}
   370	
   371		return nil, errors.Errorf("failed to rewrite %v contents", failedCount.Load())
   372	}

   374	func getContentToRewrite(ctx context.Context, rep repo.DirectRepository, opt *RewriteContentsOptions) <-chan contentInfoOrError {
   375		ch := make(chan contentInfoOrError)
   376	
   377		go func() {
   378			defer close(ch)
   379	
   380			// get content IDs listed on command line
   381			findContentInfos(ctx, rep, ch, opt.ContentIDs)
   382	
   383			// add all content IDs from short packs
   384			if opt.ShortPacks {
   385				mp, mperr := rep.ContentReader().ContentFormat().GetMutableParameters(ctx)
   386				if mperr == nil {
   387					threshold := int64(mp.MaxPackSize * shortPackThresholdPercent / 100) //nolint:mnd
   388					findContentInShortPacks(ctx, rep, ch, threshold, opt)
   389				}
   390			}
   391	
   392			// add all blocks with given format version
   393			if opt.FormatVersion != 0 {
   394				findContentWithFormatVersion(ctx, rep, ch, opt)
   395			}
   396		}()
   397	
   398		return ch
   399	}

   401	func findContentInfos(ctx context.Context, rep repo.DirectRepository, ch chan contentInfoOrError, contentIDs []content.ID) {
   402		for _, contentID := range contentIDs {
   403			i, err := rep.ContentInfo(ctx, contentID)
   404			if err != nil {
   405				ch <- contentInfoOrError{err: errors.Wrapf(err, "unable to get info for content %q", contentID)}
   406			} else {
   407				ch <- contentInfoOrError{Info: i}
   408			}
   409		}
   410	}

   412	func findContentWithFormatVersion(ctx context.Context, rep repo.DirectRepository, ch chan contentInfoOrError, opt *RewriteContentsOptions) {
   413		_ = rep.ContentReader().IterateContents(
   414			ctx,
   415			content.IterateOptions{
   416				Range:          opt.ContentIDRange,
   417				IncludeDeleted: true,
   418			},
   419			func(b content.Info) error {
   420				if int(b.FormatVersion) == opt.FormatVersion && strings.HasPrefix(string(b.PackBlobID), string(opt.PackPrefix)) {
   421					ch <- contentInfoOrError{Info: b}
   422				}
   423	
   424				return nil
   425			},
   426		)
   427	}
   428	
   429	func findContentInShortPacks(ctx context.Context, rep repo.DirectRepository, ch chan contentInfoOrError, threshold int64, opt *RewriteContentsOptions) {
   430		var prefixes []blob.ID
   431	
   432		if opt.PackPrefix != "" {
   433			prefixes = append(prefixes, opt.PackPrefix)
   434		}
   435	
   436		var (
   437			packCountByPrefix = map[blob.ID]int{}
   438			firstPackByPrefix = map[blob.ID]content.PackInfo{}
   439		)
   440	
   441		err := rep.ContentReader().IteratePacks(
   442			ctx,
   443			content.IteratePackOptions{
   444				Prefixes:                           prefixes,
   445				IncludePacksWithOnlyDeletedContent: true,
   446				IncludeContentInfos:                true,
   447			},
   448			func(pi content.PackInfo) error {
   449				if pi.TotalSize >= threshold {
   450					return nil
   451				}
   452	
   453				prefix := pi.PackID[0:1]
   454	
   455				packCountByPrefix[prefix]++
   456	
   457				if packCountByPrefix[prefix] == 1 {
   458					// do not immediately compact the first pack, in case it's the only pack.
   459					firstPackByPrefix[prefix] = pi
   460					return nil
   461				}
   462	
   463				//nolint:mnd
   464				if packCountByPrefix[prefix] == 2 {
   465					// when we encounter the 2nd pack, emit contents from the first one too.
   466					for _, ci := range firstPackByPrefix[prefix].ContentInfos {
   467						ch <- contentInfoOrError{Info: ci}
   468					}
   469	
   470					firstPackByPrefix[prefix] = content.PackInfo{}
   471				}
   472	
   473				for _, ci := range pi.ContentInfos {
   474					ch <- contentInfoOrError{Info: ci}
   475				}
   476	
   477				return nil
   478			},
   479		)
   480		if err != nil {
   481			ch <- contentInfoOrError{err: err}
   482			return
   483		}
   484	}

   486	
   487	import (
   488		"context"
   489		"crypto/aes"
   490		"crypto/cipher"
   491		"crypto/rand"
   492		"encoding/json"
   493		"time"
   494	
   495		"github.com/pkg/errors"
   496	
   497		"github.com/kopia/kopia/internal/clock"
   498		"github.com/kopia/kopia/internal/gather"
   499		"github.com/kopia/kopia/repo"

   501		"github.com/kopia/kopia/repo/maintenancestats"
   502	)
   503	
   504	const (
   505		maintenanceScheduleKeySize    = 32
   506		maintenanceScheduleBlobID     = "kopia.maintenance"
   507		maintenanceScheduleKeyPurpose = "maintenance schedule"
   508	)
   509	
   510	//nolint:gochecknoglobals
   511	var (
   512		maintenanceScheduleAEADExtraData = []byte("maintenance")
   513	)
   514	
   515	// maxRetainedRunInfoPerRunType the maximum number of retained RunInfo entries per run type.
   516	const maxRetainedRunInfoPerRunType = 50
   517	
   518	// RunInfo represents information about a single run of a maintenance task.
   519	type RunInfo struct {
   520		Start   time.Time                `json:"start"`
   521		End     time.Time                `json:"end"`
   522		Success bool                     `json:"success,omitempty"`
   523		Error   string                   `json:"error,omitempty"`
   524		Extra   []maintenancestats.Extra `json:"extra,omitempty"`
   525	}
   526	
   527	// Schedule keeps track of scheduled maintenance times.
   528	type Schedule struct {
   529		NextFullMaintenanceTime  time.Time `json:"nextFullMaintenance"`
   530		NextQuickMaintenanceTime time.Time `json:"nextQuickMaintenance"`
   531	
   532		Runs map[TaskType][]RunInfo `json:"runs"`
   533	}
   534	
   535	// ReportRun adds the provided run information to the history and discards oldest entries.
   536	func (s *Schedule) ReportRun(taskType TaskType, info RunInfo) {
   537		if s.Runs == nil {
   538			s.Runs = map[TaskType][]RunInfo{}
   539		}
   540	
   541		// insert as first item
   542		history := append([]RunInfo{info}, s.Runs[taskType]...)
   543	
   544		if len(history) > maxRetainedRunInfoPerRunType {
   545			history = history[0:maxRetainedRunInfoPerRunType]
   546		}
   547	
   548		s.Runs[taskType] = history
   549	}
   550	
   551	func getAES256GCM(rep repo.DirectRepository) (cipher.AEAD, error) {
   552		k, err := rep.DeriveKey(maintenanceScheduleKeyPurpose, maintenanceScheduleKeySize)
   553		if err != nil {
   554			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "unable to derive key for encrypting maintenance schedule blob")
   555		}
   556	
   557		c, err := aes.NewCipher(k)
   558		if err != nil {
   559			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "unable to create AES-256 cipher")
   560		}
   561	
   562		//nolint:wrapcheck
   563		return cipher.NewGCM(c)
   564	}
   565	
   566	// TimeToAttemptNextMaintenance returns the time when we should attempt next maintenance.
   567	// if the maintenance is not owned by this user, returns time.Time{}.
   568	func TimeToAttemptNextMaintenance(ctx context.Context, rep repo.DirectRepository) (time.Time, error) {
   569		mp, err := GetParams(ctx, rep)
   570		if err != nil {
   571			return time.Time{}, errors.Wrap(err, "unable to get maintenance parameters")
   572		}
   573	
   574		// if maintenance is not owned by this user, do not run maintenance here.
   575		if !mp.isOwnedByByThisUser(rep) {
   576			return time.Time{}, nil
   577		}
   578	
   579		ms, err := GetSchedule(ctx, rep)
   580		if err != nil {
   581			return time.Time{}, errors.Wrap(err, "unable to get maintenance schedule")
   582		}
   583	
   584		var nextMaintenanceTime time.Time
   585	
   586		if mp.FullCycle.Enabled {
   587			nextMaintenanceTime = ms.NextFullMaintenanceTime
   588			if nextMaintenanceTime.IsZero() {
   589				nextMaintenanceTime = clock.Now()
   590			}
   591		}
   592	
   593		if mp.QuickCycle.Enabled {
   594			if nextMaintenanceTime.IsZero() || ms.NextQuickMaintenanceTime.Before(nextMaintenanceTime) {
   595				nextMaintenanceTime = ms.NextQuickMaintenanceTime
   596				if nextMaintenanceTime.IsZero() {
   597					nextMaintenanceTime = clock.Now()
   598				}
   599			}
   600		}
   601	
   602		return nextMaintenanceTime, nil
   603	}
   604	
   605	// GetSchedule gets the scheduled maintenance times.
   606	func GetSchedule(ctx context.Context, rep repo.DirectRepository) (*Schedule, error) {
   607		var tmp gather.WriteBuffer
   608		defer tmp.Close()
   609	
   610		// read
   611		err := rep.BlobReader().GetBlob(ctx, maintenanceScheduleBlobID, 0, -1, &tmp)
   612		if errors.Is(err, blob.ErrBlobNotFound) {
   613			return &Schedule{}, nil
   614		}
   615	
   616		if err != nil {
   617			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "error reading schedule blob")
   618		}
   619	
   620		// decrypt
   621		c, err := getAES256GCM(rep)
   622		if err != nil {
   623			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "unable to get cipher")
   624		}
   625	
   626		v := tmp.ToByteSlice()
   627	
   628		if len(v) < c.NonceSize() {
   629			return nil, errors.New("invalid schedule blob")
   630		}
   631	
   632		j, err := c.Open(nil, v[0:c.NonceSize()], v[c.NonceSize():], maintenanceScheduleAEADExtraData)
   633		if err != nil {
   634			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "unable to decrypt schedule blob")
   635		}
   636	
   637		// parse JSON
   638		s := &Schedule{}
   639		if err := json.Unmarshal(j, s); err != nil {
   640			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "malformed schedule blob")
   641		}
   642	
   643		return s, nil
   644	}
   645	
   646	// SetSchedule updates scheduled maintenance times.
   647	func SetSchedule(ctx context.Context, rep repo.DirectRepositoryWriter, s *Schedule) error {
   648		// encode JSON
   649		v, err := json.Marshal(s)
   650		if err != nil {
   651			return errors.Wrap(err, "unable to serialize JSON")
   652		}
   653	
   654		// encrypt with AES-256-GCM and random nonce
   655		c, err := getAES256GCM(rep)
   656		if err != nil {
   657			return errors.Wrap(err, "unable to get cipher")
   658		}
   659	
   660		// generate random nonce
   661		nonce := make([]byte, c.NonceSize())
   662		if _, err := rand.Read(nonce); err != nil {
   663			return errors.Wrap(err, "unable to initialize nonce")
   664		}
   665	
   666		result := append([]byte(nil), nonce...)
   667		ciphertext := c.Seal(result, nonce, v, maintenanceScheduleAEADExtraData)
   668	
   669		//nolint:wrapcheck
   670		return rep.BlobStorage().PutBlob(ctx, maintenanceScheduleBlobID, gather.FromSlice(ciphertext), blob.PutOptions{})
   671	}
   672	
   673	// ReportRun reports timing of a maintenance run and persists it in repository.
   674	func ReportRun(ctx context.Context, rep repo.DirectRepositoryWriter, taskType TaskType, s *Schedule, run func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error)) error {
   675		if s == nil {
   676			var err error
   677	
   678			s, err = GetSchedule(ctx, rep)
   679			if err != nil {
   680				return errors.Wrap(err, "unable to get maintenance schedule")
   681			}
   682		}
   683	
   684		ri := RunInfo{
   685			Start: rep.Time(),
   686		}
   687	
   688		stats, runErr := run()
   689	
   690		ri.End = rep.Time()
   691	
   692		if runErr != nil {
   693			ri.Error = runErr.Error()
   694		} else {
   695			ri.Success = true
   696			ri.Extra = buildRunStats(ctx, stats)
   697		}
   698	
   699		s.ReportRun(taskType, ri)
   700	
   701		if err := SetSchedule(ctx, rep, s); err != nil {
   702			userLog(ctx).Errorf("unable to report run: %v", err)
   703		}
   704	
   705		return runErr
   706	}
   707	
   708	func buildRunStats(ctx context.Context, stats maintenancestats.Kind) []maintenancestats.Extra {
   709		if stats == nil {
   710			return nil
   711		}
   712	
   713		extra, err := maintenancestats.BuildExtra(stats)
   714		if err != nil {
   715			userLog(ctx).Warnf("error building raw data from stats %v, err %v", stats, err)
   716			return nil
   717		}
   718	
   719		return []maintenancestats.Extra{extra}
   720	}

    20	// DeleteUnreferencedPacksOptions provides option for pack garbage collection algorithm.
    21	type DeleteUnreferencedPacksOptions struct {
    22		Parallel     int
    23		Prefix       blob.ID
    24		DryRun       bool
    25		NotAfterTime time.Time
    26	}
    27	
    28	// DeleteUnreferencedPacks deletes pack blobs that are unreferenced by index entries.
    29	//
    30	//nolint:gocyclo,funlen
    31	func DeleteUnreferencedPacks(ctx context.Context, rep repo.DirectRepositoryWriter, opt DeleteUnreferencedPacksOptions, safety SafetyParameters) (*maintenancestats.DeleteUnreferencedPacksStats, error) {
    32		ctx = contentlog.WithParams(ctx,
    33			logparam.String("span:pack-gc", contentlog.RandomSpanID()))
    34	
    35		log := rep.LogManager().NewLogger("maintenance-pack-gc")
    36	
    37		if opt.Parallel == 0 {
    38			opt.Parallel = 16
    39		}
    40	
    41		const deleteQueueSize = 100
    42	
    43		var unreferenced, deleted, retained stats.CountSum
    44	
    45		var eg errgroup.Group
    46	
    47		unused := make(chan blob.Metadata, deleteQueueSize)
    48	
    49		if !opt.DryRun {
    50			// start goroutines to delete packs as they come.
    51			for range opt.Parallel {
    52				eg.Go(func() error {
    53					for bm := range unused {
    54						if err := rep.BlobStorage().DeleteBlob(ctx, bm.BlobID); err != nil {
    55							return errors.Wrapf(err, "unable to delete pack blob %q", bm.BlobID)
    56						}
    57	
    58						cnt, del := deleted.Add(bm.Length)
    59						if cnt%100 == 0 {
    60							contentlog.Log2(ctx, log, "deleted unreferenced pack blobs", logparam.UInt32("count", cnt), logparam.Int64("bytes", del))
    61						}
    62					}
    63	
    64					return nil
    65				})
    66			}
    67		}
    68	
    69		// iterate unreferenced packs and count them + optionally send to the channel to be deleted
    70		contentlog.Log(ctx, log, "Looking for unreferenced pack blobs...")
    71	
    72		var prefixes []blob.ID
    73		if p := opt.Prefix; p != "" {
    74			prefixes = append(prefixes, p)
    75		} else {
    76			prefixes = append(prefixes, content.PackBlobIDPrefixRegular, content.PackBlobIDPrefixSpecial, content.BlobIDPrefixSession)
    77		}
    78	
    79		activeSessions, err := rep.ContentManager().ListActiveSessions(ctx)
    80		if err != nil {
    81			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "unable to load active sessions")
    82		}
    83	
    84		cutoffTime := opt.NotAfterTime
    85		if cutoffTime.IsZero() {
    86			cutoffTime = rep.Time()
    87		}
    88	
    89		// move the cutoff time a bit forward, because on Windows clock does not reliably move forward so we may end
    90		// up not deleting some blobs - this only really affects tests, since BlobDeleteMinAge provides real
    91		// protection here.
    92		const cutoffTimeSlack = 1 * time.Second
    93	
    94		cutoffTime = cutoffTime.Add(cutoffTimeSlack)
    95	
    96		// iterate all pack blobs + session blobs and keep ones that are too young or
    97		// belong to alive sessions.
    98		if err := rep.ContentManager().IterateUnreferencedPacks(ctx, prefixes, opt.Parallel, func(bm blob.Metadata) error {
    99			if bm.Timestamp.After(cutoffTime) {
   100				retained.Add(bm.Length)
   101	
   102				contentlog.Log3(ctx, log,
   103					"preserving pack - after cutoff time",
   104					blobparam.BlobID("blobID", bm.BlobID),
   105					logparam.Time("cutoffTime", cutoffTime),
   106					logparam.Time("timestamp", bm.Timestamp))
   107	
   108				return nil
   109			}
   110	
   111			if age := cutoffTime.Sub(bm.Timestamp); age < safety.PackDeleteMinAge {
   112				retained.Add(bm.Length)
   113	
   114				contentlog.Log2(ctx, log,
   115					"preserving pack - below min age",
   116					blobparam.BlobID("blobID", bm.BlobID),
   117					logparam.Duration("age", age))
   118	
   119				return nil
   120			}
   121	
   122			sid := content.SessionIDFromBlobID(bm.BlobID)
   123			if s, ok := activeSessions[sid]; ok {
   124				if age := cutoffTime.Sub(s.CheckpointTime); age < safety.SessionExpirationAge {
   125					retained.Add(bm.Length)
   126	
   127					contentlog.Log2(ctx, log,
   128						"preserving pack - part of active session",
   129						blobparam.BlobID("blobID", bm.BlobID),
   130						logparam.String("sessionID", string(sid)))
   131	
   132					return nil
   133				}
   134			}
   135	
   136			unreferenced.Add(bm.Length)
   137	
   138			if !opt.DryRun {
   139				unused <- bm
   140			}
   141	
   142			return nil
   143		}); err != nil {
   144			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "error looking for unreferenced pack blobs")
   145		}
   146	
   147		close(unused)
   148	
   149		unreferencedCount, unreferencedSize := unreferenced.Approximate()
   150		retainedCount, retainedSize := retained.Approximate()
   151	
   152		result := &maintenancestats.DeleteUnreferencedPacksStats{
   153			UnreferencedPackCount: uint64(unreferencedCount),
   154			UnreferencedTotalSize: maintenancestats.ToUint64(unreferencedSize),
   155			RetainedPackCount:     uint64(retainedCount),

   166		}

   175	
   176		contentlog.Log1(ctx, log, "Completed deleting unreferenced pack blobs", result)
   177	
   178		return result, nil
   179	}

   232	const parallelContentRewritesCPUMultiplier = 2
   233	
   234	// RewriteContentsOptions provides options for RewriteContents.
   235	type RewriteContentsOptions struct {
   236		Parallel       int
   237		ContentIDs     []content.ID
   238		ContentIDRange content.IDRange

   251	
   252	// RewriteContents rewrites contents according to provided criteria and creates new
   253	// blobs and index entries to point at them.
   254	//
   255	//nolint:funlen
   256	func RewriteContents(ctx context.Context, rep repo.DirectRepositoryWriter, opt *RewriteContentsOptions, safety SafetyParameters) (*maintenancestats.RewriteContentsStats, error) {
   257		ctx = contentlog.WithParams(ctx,
   258			logparam.String("span:content-rewrite", contentlog.RandomSpanID()))
   259	
   260		log := rep.LogManager().NewLogger("maintenance-content-rewrite")
   261	
   262		if opt == nil {
   263			return nil, errors.New("missing options")
   264		}
   265	
   266		if opt.ShortPacks {
   267			contentlog.Log(ctx, log, "Rewriting contents from short packs...")
   268		} else {
   269			contentlog.Log(ctx, log, "Rewriting contents...")
   270		}
   271	
   272		cnt := getContentToRewrite(ctx, rep, opt)
   273	
   274		var (
   275			toRewrite, retained, rewritten stats.CountSum
   276			failedCount                    atomic.Uint64
   277		)
   278	
   279		if opt.Parallel == 0 {
   280			opt.Parallel = runtime.NumCPU() * parallelContentRewritesCPUMultiplier
   281		}
   282	
   283		var wg sync.WaitGroup
   284	
   285		for range opt.Parallel {
   286			wg.Go(func() {
   287				for c := range cnt {
   288					if c.err != nil {
   289						failedCount.Add(1)
   290	
   291						return
   292					}
   293	
   294					age := rep.Time().Sub(c.Timestamp())
   295					if age < safety.RewriteMinAge {
   296						contentlog.Log5(ctx, log,
   297							"Not rewriting content",
   298							contentparam.ContentID("contentID", c.ContentID),
   299							logparam.UInt32("bytes", c.PackedLength),
   300							blobparam.BlobID("packBlobID", c.PackBlobID),
   301							logparam.Bool("deleted", c.Deleted),
   302							logparam.Duration("age", age))
   303	
   304						retained.Add(int64(c.PackedLength))
   305	
   306						continue
   307					}
   308	
   309					contentlog.Log5(ctx, log,
   310						"Rewriting content",
   311						contentparam.ContentID("contentID", c.ContentID),
   312						logparam.UInt32("bytes", c.PackedLength),
   313						blobparam.BlobID("packBlobID", c.PackBlobID),
   314						logparam.Bool("deleted", c.Deleted),
   315						logparam.Duration("age", age))
   316	
   317					toRewrite.Add(int64(c.PackedLength))
   318	
   319					if opt.DryRun {
   320						continue
   321					}
   322	
   323					if err := rep.ContentManager().RewriteContent(ctx, c.ContentID); err != nil {
   324						// provide option to ignore failures when rewriting deleted contents during maintenance
   325						// this is for advanced use only
   326						if envflag.Bool("KOPIA_IGNORE_MAINTENANCE_REWRITE_ERROR") && c.Deleted {
   327							contentlog.Log2(ctx, log,
   328								"IGNORED: unable to rewrite deleted content",
   329								contentparam.ContentID("contentID", c.ContentID),
   330								logparam.Error("error", err))
   331						} else {
   332							contentlog.Log2(ctx, log,
   333								"unable to rewrite content",
   334								contentparam.ContentID("contentID", c.ContentID),
   335								logparam.Error("error", err))
   336	
   337							failedCount.Add(1)
   338						}
   339					} else {
   340						rewritten.Add(int64(c.PackedLength))
   341					}
   342				}
   343			})
   344		}
   345	
   346		wg.Wait()
   347	
   348		toRewriteCount, toRewriteBytes := toRewrite.Approximate()
   349		retainedCount, retainedBytes := retained.Approximate()
   350		rewrittenCount, rewrittenBytes := rewritten.Approximate()
   351	
   352		result := &maintenancestats.RewriteContentsStats{
   353			ToRewriteContentCount: uint64(toRewriteCount),
   354			ToRewriteContentSize:  maintenancestats.ToUint64(toRewriteBytes),
   355			RewrittenContentCount: uint64(rewrittenCount),
   356			RewrittenContentSize:  maintenancestats.ToUint64(rewrittenBytes),
   357			RetainedContentCount:  uint64(retainedCount),
   358			RetainedContentSize:   maintenancestats.ToUint64(retainedBytes),
   359		}
   360	
   361		contentlog.Log1(ctx, log, "Rewritten contents", result)
   362	
   363		if failedCount.Load() == 0 {
   364			if err := rep.ContentManager().Flush(ctx); err != nil {
   365				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "error flushing repo")
   366			}
   367	
   368			return result, nil
   369		}
   370	
   371		return nil, errors.Errorf("failed to rewrite %v contents", failedCount.Load())
   372	}

   374	func getContentToRewrite(ctx context.Context, rep repo.DirectRepository, opt *RewriteContentsOptions) <-chan contentInfoOrError {
   375		ch := make(chan contentInfoOrError)
   376	
   377		go func() {
   378			defer close(ch)
   379	
   380			// get content IDs listed on command line
   381			findContentInfos(ctx, rep, ch, opt.ContentIDs)
   382	
   383			// add all content IDs from short packs
   384			if opt.ShortPacks {
   385				mp, mperr := rep.ContentReader().ContentFormat().GetMutableParameters(ctx)
   386				if mperr == nil {
   387					threshold := int64(mp.MaxPackSize * shortPackThresholdPercent / 100) //nolint:mnd
   388					findContentInShortPacks(ctx, rep, ch, threshold, opt)
   389				}
   390			}
   391	
   392			// add all blocks with given format version
   393			if opt.FormatVersion != 0 {
   394				findContentWithFormatVersion(ctx, rep, ch, opt)
   395			}
   396		}()
   397	
   398		return ch
   399	}
   400	
   401	func findContentInfos(ctx context.Context, rep repo.DirectRepository, ch chan contentInfoOrError, contentIDs []content.ID) {
   402		for _, contentID := range contentIDs {
   403			i, err := rep.ContentInfo(ctx, contentID)
   404			if err != nil {
   405				ch <- contentInfoOrError{err: errors.Wrapf(err, "unable to get info for content %q", contentID)}
   406			} else {
   407				ch <- contentInfoOrError{Info: i}
   408			}
   409		}
   410	}
   411	
   412	func findContentWithFormatVersion(ctx context.Context, rep repo.DirectRepository, ch chan contentInfoOrError, opt *RewriteContentsOptions) {
   413		_ = rep.ContentReader().IterateContents(
   414			ctx,
   415			content.IterateOptions{
   416				Range:          opt.ContentIDRange,
   417				IncludeDeleted: true,
   418			},
   419			func(b content.Info) error {
   420				if int(b.FormatVersion) == opt.FormatVersion && strings.HasPrefix(string(b.PackBlobID), string(opt.PackPrefix)) {
   421					ch <- contentInfoOrError{Info: b}
   422				}
   423	
   424				return nil
   425			},
   426		)
   427	}
   428	
   429	func findContentInShortPacks(ctx context.Context, rep repo.DirectRepository, ch chan contentInfoOrError, threshold int64, opt *RewriteContentsOptions) {
   430		var prefixes []blob.ID
   431	
   432		if opt.PackPrefix != "" {
   433			prefixes = append(prefixes, opt.PackPrefix)
   434		}
   435	
   436		var (
   437			packCountByPrefix = map[blob.ID]int{}
   438			firstPackByPrefix = map[blob.ID]content.PackInfo{}
   439		)
   440	
   441		err := rep.ContentReader().IteratePacks(
   442			ctx,
   443			content.IteratePackOptions{
   444				Prefixes:                           prefixes,
   445				IncludePacksWithOnlyDeletedContent: true,
   446				IncludeContentInfos:                true,
   447			},
   448			func(pi content.PackInfo) error {
   449				if pi.TotalSize >= threshold {
   450					return nil
   451				}
   452	
   453				prefix := pi.PackID[0:1]
   454	
   455				packCountByPrefix[prefix]++
   456	
   457				if packCountByPrefix[prefix] == 1 {
   458					// do not immediately compact the first pack, in case it's the only pack.
   459					firstPackByPrefix[prefix] = pi
   460					return nil
   461				}
   462	
   463				//nolint:mnd
   464				if packCountByPrefix[prefix] == 2 {
   465					// when we encounter the 2nd pack, emit contents from the first one too.
   466					for _, ci := range firstPackByPrefix[prefix].ContentInfos {
   467						ch <- contentInfoOrError{Info: ci}
   468					}
   469	
   470					firstPackByPrefix[prefix] = content.PackInfo{}
   471				}
   472	
   473				for _, ci := range pi.ContentInfos {
   474					ch <- contentInfoOrError{Info: ci}
   475				}
   476	
   477				return nil
   478			},
   479		)
   480		if err != nil {
   481			ch <- contentInfoOrError{err: err}
   482			return
   483		}
   484	}
   485	package maintenance
   486	
   487	import (
   488		"context"
   489		"crypto/aes"
   490		"crypto/cipher"
   491		"crypto/rand"
   492		"encoding/json"
   493		"time"
   494	
   495		"github.com/pkg/errors"
   496	
   497		"github.com/kopia/kopia/internal/clock"
   498		"github.com/kopia/kopia/internal/gather"
   499		"github.com/kopia/kopia/repo"
   500		"github.com/kopia/kopia/repo/blob"
   501		"github.com/kopia/kopia/repo/maintenancestats"
   502	)
   503	
   504	const (
   505		maintenanceScheduleKeySize    = 32
   506		maintenanceScheduleBlobID     = "kopia.maintenance"
   507		maintenanceScheduleKeyPurpose = "maintenance schedule"
   508	)
   509	
   510	//nolint:gochecknoglobals
   511	var (
   512		maintenanceScheduleAEADExtraData = []byte("maintenance")
   513	)
   514	
   515	// maxRetainedRunInfoPerRunType the maximum number of retained RunInfo entries per run type.
   516	const maxRetainedRunInfoPerRunType = 50
   517	
   518	// RunInfo represents information about a single run of a maintenance task.
   519	type RunInfo struct {
   520		Start   time.Time                `json:"start"`
   521		End     time.Time                `json:"end"`
   522		Success bool                     `json:"success,omitempty"`
   523		Error   string                   `json:"error,omitempty"`
   524		Extra   []maintenancestats.Extra `json:"extra,omitempty"`
   525	}
   526	
   527	// Schedule keeps track of scheduled maintenance times.
   528	type Schedule struct {
   529		NextFullMaintenanceTime  time.Time `json:"nextFullMaintenance"`
   530		NextQuickMaintenanceTime time.Time `json:"nextQuickMaintenance"`
   531	
   532		Runs map[TaskType][]RunInfo `json:"runs"`
   533	}
   534	
   535	// ReportRun adds the provided run information to the history and discards oldest entries.
   536	func (s *Schedule) ReportRun(taskType TaskType, info RunInfo) {
   537		if s.Runs == nil {
   538			s.Runs = map[TaskType][]RunInfo{}
   539		}
   540	
   541		// insert as first item
   542		history := append([]RunInfo{info}, s.Runs[taskType]...)
   543	
   544		if len(history) > maxRetainedRunInfoPerRunType {
   545			history = history[0:maxRetainedRunInfoPerRunType]
   546		}
   547	
   548		s.Runs[taskType] = history
   549	}
   550	
   551	func getAES256GCM(rep repo.DirectRepository) (cipher.AEAD, error) {
   552		k, err := rep.DeriveKey(maintenanceScheduleKeyPurpose, maintenanceScheduleKeySize)
   553		if err != nil {
   554			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "unable to derive key for encrypting maintenance schedule blob")
   555		}
   556	
   557		c, err := aes.NewCipher(k)
   558		if err != nil {
   559			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "unable to create AES-256 cipher")
   560		}
   561	
   562		//nolint:wrapcheck
   563		return cipher.NewGCM(c)
   564	}
   565	
   566	// TimeToAttemptNextMaintenance returns the time when we should attempt next maintenance.
   567	// if the maintenance is not owned by this user, returns time.Time{}.
   568	func TimeToAttemptNextMaintenance(ctx context.Context, rep repo.DirectRepository) (time.Time, error) {
   569		mp, err := GetParams(ctx, rep)
   570		if err != nil {
   571			return time.Time{}, errors.Wrap(err, "unable to get maintenance parameters")
   572		}
   573	
   574		// if maintenance is not owned by this user, do not run maintenance here.
   575		if !mp.isOwnedByByThisUser(rep) {
   576			return time.Time{}, nil
   577		}
   578	
   579		ms, err := GetSchedule(ctx, rep)
   580		if err != nil {
   581			return time.Time{}, errors.Wrap(err, "unable to get maintenance schedule")
   582		}
   583	
   584		var nextMaintenanceTime time.Time
   585	
   586		if mp.FullCycle.Enabled {
   587			nextMaintenanceTime = ms.NextFullMaintenanceTime
   588			if nextMaintenanceTime.IsZero() {
   589				nextMaintenanceTime = clock.Now()
   590			}
   591		}
   592	
   593		if mp.QuickCycle.Enabled {
   594			if nextMaintenanceTime.IsZero() || ms.NextQuickMaintenanceTime.Before(nextMaintenanceTime) {
   595				nextMaintenanceTime = ms.NextQuickMaintenanceTime
   596				if nextMaintenanceTime.IsZero() {
   597					nextMaintenanceTime = clock.Now()
   598				}
   599			}
   600		}
   601	
   602		return nextMaintenanceTime, nil
   603	}
   604	
   605	// GetSchedule gets the scheduled maintenance times.
   606	func GetSchedule(ctx context.Context, rep repo.DirectRepository) (*Schedule, error) {
   607		var tmp gather.WriteBuffer
   608		defer tmp.Close()
   609	
   610		// read
   611		err := rep.BlobReader().GetBlob(ctx, maintenanceScheduleBlobID, 0, -1, &tmp)
   612		if errors.Is(err, blob.ErrBlobNotFound) {
   613			return &Schedule{}, nil
   614		}
   615	
   616		if err != nil {
   617			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "error reading schedule blob")
   618		}
   619	
   620		// decrypt
   621		c, err := getAES256GCM(rep)
   622		if err != nil {
   623			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "unable to get cipher")
   624		}
   625	
   626		v := tmp.ToByteSlice()
   627	
   628		if len(v) < c.NonceSize() {
   629			return nil, errors.New("invalid schedule blob")
   630		}
   631	
   632		j, err := c.Open(nil, v[0:c.NonceSize()], v[c.NonceSize():], maintenanceScheduleAEADExtraData)
   633		if err != nil {
   634			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "unable to decrypt schedule blob")
   635		}
   636	
   637		// parse JSON
   638		s := &Schedule{}
   639		if err := json.Unmarshal(j, s); err != nil {
   640			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "malformed schedule blob")
   641		}
   642	
   643		return s, nil
   644	}
   645	
   646	// SetSchedule updates scheduled maintenance times.
   647	func SetSchedule(ctx context.Context, rep repo.DirectRepositoryWriter, s *Schedule) error {
   648		// encode JSON
   649		v, err := json.Marshal(s)
   650		if err != nil {
   651			return errors.Wrap(err, "unable to serialize JSON")
   652		}
   653	
   654		// encrypt with AES-256-GCM and random nonce
   655		c, err := getAES256GCM(rep)
   656		if err != nil {
   657			return errors.Wrap(err, "unable to get cipher")
   658		}
   659	
   660		// generate random nonce
   661		nonce := make([]byte, c.NonceSize())
   662		if _, err := rand.Read(nonce); err != nil {
   663			return errors.Wrap(err, "unable to initialize nonce")
   664		}
   665	
   666		result := append([]byte(nil), nonce...)
   667		ciphertext := c.Seal(result, nonce, v, maintenanceScheduleAEADExtraData)
   668	
   669		//nolint:wrapcheck
   670		return rep.BlobStorage().PutBlob(ctx, maintenanceScheduleBlobID, gather.FromSlice(ciphertext), blob.PutOptions{})
   671	}
   672	
   673	// ReportRun reports timing of a maintenance run and persists it in repository.
   674	func ReportRun(ctx context.Context, rep repo.DirectRepositoryWriter, taskType TaskType, s *Schedule, run func() (maintenancestats.Kind, error)) error {
   675		if s == nil {
   676			var err error
   677	
   678			s, err = GetSchedule(ctx, rep)
   679			if err != nil {
   680				return errors.Wrap(err, "unable to get maintenance schedule")
   681			}
   682		}
   683	
   684		ri := RunInfo{
   685			Start: rep.Time(),
   686		}
   687	
   688		stats, runErr := run()
   689	
   690		ri.End = rep.Time()
   691	
   692		if runErr != nil {
   693			ri.Error = runErr.Error()
   694		} else {
   695			ri.Success = true
   696			ri.Extra = buildRunStats(ctx, stats)
   697		}
   698	
   699		s.ReportRun(taskType, ri)
   700	
   701		if err := SetSchedule(ctx, rep, s); err != nil {
   702			userLog(ctx).Errorf("unable to report run: %v", err)
   703		}
   704	
   705		return runErr
   706	}
   707	
   708	func buildRunStats(ctx context.Context, stats maintenancestats.Kind) []maintenancestats.Extra {
   709		if stats == nil {
   710			return nil
   711		}
   712	
   713		extra, err := maintenancestats.BuildExtra(stats)
   714		if err != nil {
   715			userLog(ctx).Warnf("error building raw data from stats %v, err %v", stats, err)
   716			return nil
   717		}
   718	
   719		return []maintenancestats.Extra{extra}
   720	}

input.prompt:
Read-only bug audit of Kopia (Go backup tool), repo at /exp/PREWORK_omm6rx1i/model_a (unmodified upstream master, Nov 2026). Do NOT edit any files, do not commit. You may write and run throwaway Go tests ONLY under a temp copy or by adding a _test.go file that you delete afterwards (prefer just reading; run `go test ./snapshot/upload/ -run X` only when it settles a doubt cheaply).

Deployment being evaluated: 12 laptops (which sleep/suspend, lose network, get closed mid-backup) run scheduled snapshots into one shared S3 repository; each connects directly to the repo.

Your scope: the snapshot creation path. Find real, code-level bugs that could make a snapshot silently incomplete, wrong, or unrestorable, or lose data. Files to read fully and carefully:
- snapshot/upload/*.go (non-test): upload.go, upload_scan.go, checkpoint registry, upload estimator, actions, os snapshot
- snapshot/manager.go, snapshot/manifest.go, snapshot/source.go
- snapshot/snapshotfs/dir_manifest_builder.go, dir_writer / dir_rewriter, source_directories, and anything upload.go calls from that package
- fs/localfs (entry stat/readdir, error handling), fs/ignorefs (ignore rules: could files be wrongly excluded?), fs/virtualfs only if used
- cli/command_snapshot_create.go (how previous manifests are picked, how errors/ignored errors affect exit status and whether a manifest is still saved, how --fail-fast / error-handling policy behaves)

Questions to answer with evidence (file:line and the exact code), not speculation:
1. Previous-snapshot reuse ("hash cache"): under what exact conditions is a file treated as unchanged and its old object ID reused without reading the file? Can a changed file be skipped (mtime granularity, size-only, zero mtime, clock changes, owner/mode-only changes)? Is the existence of the reused object in the repository ever verified? Which previous manifests are eligible (incomplete ones? ones from other hosts/users? ones with errors?), and can a partially-failed previous snapshot poison later ones?
2. Checkpointing (every ~45 min): what gets written, is the checkpoint manifest consistent, what happens to in-flight files/dirs, can a checkpoint be saved that references objects never flushed? What happens when a checkpoint save fails?
3. Error handling: file read errors, directory read errors, files changing/truncated/growing during read, permission errors. Which are ignored by default policy, and does the resulting snapshot get marked incomplete / record the failure? Any path where an error is swallowed and an entry silently dropped from the directory listing or stored with truncated content while the snapshot reports success?
4. Cancellation / interruption (context cancel, process kill, network loss, Flush failure): can a manifest be saved that references content that was never durably written? Order of Flush vs manifest save.
5. Concurrency bugs in the parallel uploader: shared state without locks, results attached to the wrong entry, dir manifest ordering/dedup, summary stats.
6. Anything else that yields wrong data in a snapshot (symlinks, hardlinks, sparse files, large files concatenation `concatenate`, streaming files, one-file-system, ignore-cache-dirs, max file size policy, case-insensitive name collisions).

input.description: Audit policy and retention application
input.prompt:
Read-only bug audit of Kopia (Go backup tool), repo at /exp/PREWORK_omm6rx1i/model_a (unmodified upstream master, Nov 2026). Do NOT edit tracked files, do not commit. You may write a throwaway `_test.go` file to prove a suspected bug by running it (`go test ./snapshot/policy/ -run Name`), but delete it afterwards and confirm `git status` is clean.

Deployment being evaluated: 12 laptops run scheduled snapshots into one shared S3 repository (each connects directly, different user@host). Retention is configured per folder (policies set on user@host:/path, on parent directories, on host, on user@host, and global), and applied automatically after each snapshot and via `kopia snapshot expire`.

Your scope: policy resolution and retention application. Find real, code-level bugs that cause WRONG RETENTION: snapshots deleted that should be kept, or kept when they should expire, or the wrong policy being applied to a folder. Read fully:
- snapshot/policy/*.go (non-test): policy_manager.go (GetEffectivePolicy, parent walking, GetPolicyByID, labels, path handling incl. Windows paths and trailing slashes), policy_merge.go, policy_tree.go, optional.go, retention_policy.go, expire.go, scheduling_policy.go, policy.go
- snapshot/manager.go (ListSnapshots, GroupBySource, SortByTime, LoadSnapshots, FindPreviousManifests), snapshot/source.go (SourceInfo parsing)
- cli/command_snapshot_create.go (post-snapshot retention application), cli/command_snapshot_expire.go, cli/command_snapshot_delete.go, cli/command_snapshot_pin.go, cli/command_policy_set*.go (retention flags parsing, "inherit", zero values), cli/command_snapshot_list.go only for how retention reasons are computed
- internal/server/source_manager.go and internal/server/api_snapshots.go / api_sources.go / api_policies.go (how the server / KopiaUI schedules snapshots and applies retention; missed-schedule handling), internal/server/grpc_session.go ApplyRetentionPolicy
- snapshot/policy/policy_manager.go applicable-policies logic for subdirectories, and how policy on a parent folder applies to a snapshot source in a child folder and vice versa

Specific things to work through with concrete examples (compute by hand or with a throwaway test):
1. ComputeRetentionReasons / getRetentionReasons in retention_policy.go: the shared `ids` map keyed by timePeriodID across period types (collisions between e.g. "latest" index strings and year strings?), the cutoff times based on the latest *complete* snapshot, behaviour when all snapshots are incomplete, when the latest is incomplete, when snapshots have identical start times, timezone used for bucketing (UTC vs local) and its effect on daily/weekly/monthly boundaries, ISO week/year at year boundaries, EffectiveKeepLatest when everything is 0 or unset, keepLatest=0 with others set, negative values, IgnoreIdenticalSnapshots handling (where is it implemented and can it delete the wrong one?).
2. Which snapshots are grouped together for expiration: does the grouping key include path, user, host exactly? Case sensitivity, path normalization, trailing slash, Windows drive letter. Could two laptops with the same hostname/username share a retention group and expire each other's snapshots? What do default hostname/username come from?
3. Pins and tags: are pinned snapshots always exempt?
4. Policy merge order: is a child-folder policy correctly overriding parents; is `NoParent` honoured; are nil vs zero OptionalInt distinguished; does mergeOptionalInt use the most specific value? Is the policy for the snapshot *source path* used, or something else? Is there any path where the default policy (keep 10 latest, 48 hourly, 7 daily, 4 weekly, 24 monthly, 3 annual) silently replaces the configured one (e.g. policy lookup error, policy manifest not yet visible, policy set after sources are loaded in the server)?
5. Auto-expire after snapshot: does it run when the snapshot failed/incomplete/had ignored errors? Does a failed/partial latest snapshot push out good older ones? Is it possible for expiration to delete the only complete snapshot?
6. Clock problems: a laptop with a wrong clock (far future start time) - what does it do to cutoffs and to other snapshots in the same group?
7. Scheduling policy: missed runs when laptop asleep (RunMissed), timezone, NextSnapshotTime correctness, anything that makes snapshots silently not happen.

input.prompt:

Your scope has two parts.

PART 1 - blob storage layer. Read fully: repo/blob/s3/*.go (non-test), repo/blob/storage.go, repo/blob/retrying/, repo/blob/readonly, repo/blob/throttling/, repo/blob/logging, repo/blob/beforeop, repo/blob/storagemetrics, repo/blob/sharded only if S3 uses it, internal/retry, repo/blob/storage_extend.go / blob retention code (repo/maintenance/blob_retain.go), internal/cache (persistent LRU cache, content cache, metadata cache: repo/content cache usage of cached blobs - can a stale/corrupt/truncated cache entry be served? is cache content authenticated?), internal/listcache (cached blob listings: staleness, how long, invalidation on put/delete, can a stale list hide index blobs or resurrect deleted ones?), internal/ownwrites (own-writes cache: merging logic, expiry).
Look for: PutBlob partial/incorrect writes reported as success, retry of non-idempotent operations, errors mapped wrongly (e.g. a transient error or access-denied mapped to ErrBlobNotFound, or NotFound swallowed), ListBlobs returning incomplete results without error (pagination, prefix handling, versioned buckets with delete markers, point-in-time), GetBlob range handling/short reads, GetMetadata timestamps (which timestamp is used; maintenance relies on blob Timestamp for age-based safety), DeleteBlob semantics on versioned/object-locked buckets, PutOptions (RetentionMode/RetentionPeriod, SetModTime, GetModTime, DoNotRecreate) correctness, storage class / Glacier handling, context cancellation mid-upload.
